source.text: דְּבַר־יְהוָ֣ה׀אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־צְפַנְיָה֙ בֶּן־כּוּשִׁ֣י בֶן־גְּדַלְיָ֔ה בֶּן־אֲמַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־חִזְקִיָּ֑ה בִּימֵ֛י יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־אָמ֖וֹן מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: The word of Yahweh which came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, in [the] days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.

en.L: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} which came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s word came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, during the reign of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.
en.R: This is the message {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave to Zephaniah son of Cushi. His family line went back through Gedaliah and Amariah to Hezekiah. The message came while Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah.

es.L: Palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que vino a Sofonías hijo de Cusí, hijo de Gedalías, hijo de Amarías, hijo de Ezequías, en los días de Josías hijo de Amón, rey de Judá.
es.B: Este mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a Sofonías hijo de Cusí, hijo de Gedalías, hijo de Amarías, hijo de Ezequías, durante el reinado de Josías hijo de Amón, rey de Judá.
es.R: Este es el mensaje que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio a Sofonías hijo de Cusí. Su linaje se remontaba, por Gedalías y Amarías, hasta Ezequías. El mensaje le llegó cuando Josías hijo de Amón era rey de Judá.

fr.L: La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui fut adressée à Sophonie fils de Koushi, fils de Guedalia, fils d’Amaria, fils d’Ézéchias, aux jours de Josias fils d’Amon, roi de Juda.
fr.B: La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée à Sophonie fils de Koushi, fils de Guedalia, fils d’Amaria, fils d’Ézéchias, sous le règne de Josias fils d’Amon, roi de Juda.
fr.R: Voici le message que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné à Sophonie fils de Koushi. Sa famille remontait, par Guedalia et Amaria, jusqu’à Ézéchias. Ce message est venu quand Josias fils d’Amon était roi de Juda.

sw.L: Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lililomjia Sefania mwana wa Kushi, mwana wa Gedalia, mwana wa Amaria, mwana wa Hezekia, katika siku za Yosia mwana wa Amoni, mfalme wa Yuda.
sw.B: Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilimjia Sefania mwana wa Kushi, mwana wa Gedalia, mwana wa Amaria, mwana wa Hezekia, wakati wa utawala wa Yosia mwana wa Amoni, mfalme wa Yuda.
sw.R: Huu ndio ujumbe ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpa Sefania mwana wa Kushi. Ukoo wake ulirudi nyuma kupitia Gedalia na Amaria hadi kwa Hezekia. Ujumbe huo ulimjia wakati Yosia mwana wa Amoni alipokuwa mfalme wa Yuda.

vi.L: Lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đến với Sô-phô-ni con trai Cút-si, con trai Ghê-đa-lia, con trai A-ma-ria, con trai Ê-xê-chia, trong đời Giô-si-a con trai A-môn, vua Giu-đa.
vi.B: Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Sô-phô-ni con trai Cút-si, cháu Ghê-đa-lia, chắt A-ma-ria, chít Ê-xê-chia, dưới triều Giô-si-a con trai A-môn, vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: Đây là sứ điệp {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho Sô-phô-ni con trai Cút-si. Dòng họ ông truy ngược qua Ghê-đa-lia và A-ma-ria đến tận Ê-xê-chia. Sứ điệp ấy đến khi Giô-si-a con trai A-môn làm vua Giu-đa.

ko.L: 유다 왕 아몬의 아들 요시야의 시대에, 히스기야의 현손이요 아마랴의 증손이요 그다랴의 손자요 구시의 아들인 스바냐에게 임한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 히스기야의 현손이요 아마랴의 증손이요 그다랴의 손자요 구시의 아들인 스바냐에게 임했다. 그때는 아몬의 아들 요시야가 유다를 다스리던 때였다.
ko.R: 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 구시의 아들 스바냐에게 주신 말씀이다. 스바냐의 집안은 그다랴와 아마랴를 거쳐 히스기야에게까지 거슬러 올라간다. 이 말씀은 아몬의 아들 요시야가 유다의 왕이었을 때에 임했다.

decisions.choice: the word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah: the heading of the whole book
decisions.reason: The same heading opens Hosea, Joel and Micah. It presents all that follows, the warnings to Judah, the oracles against the nations and the promises of chapter 3, as one message from the LORD, given through a particular man at a particular time. The heading is prose; the poems begin in verse 2. |

decisions.choice: in the days of Josiah: Zephaniah spoke during Josiah's reign over Judah, about 640-609 BC
decisions.reason: Josiah came to the throne as a boy after the murder of his father Amon (2 Kings 21:23-22:1). In his eighteenth year, about 622 BC, he purged the temple and the land of the worship of Baal, the host of heaven and the idol priests (2 Kings 23:4-14). The practices Zephaniah condemns in 1:4-6 are the ones that purge removed, so many date his preaching before it or early in it. The heading itself gives no year. |

decisions.choice: a family line of four generations, back to Hezekiah
decisions.reason: Prophets are usually named with their father only. Zephaniah's line is traced back four generations, perhaps because the last name is that of King Hezekiah of Judah (about 715-686 BC), which would make the prophet a distant member of the royal family. The text does not call this Hezekiah king, so the identification cannot be certain. His father's name, Cushi, can also mean "the Cushite", but here it is a personal name, as in Jeremiah 36:14.

decisions.choice: The word of the LORD which came to (L); The LORD's word came to (B); in the days of (L), during the reign of (B), while ... was king (R)
decisions.reason: The heading follows the wording set for the Twelve and published in Hosea 1:1 and Joel 1:1, which follows the Jeremiah table for dated headings. Readable splits the long heading into three sentences and gives the generations as a family line, without adding anything to them. |

decisions.choice: "Palabra del SEÑOR que vino a" (L); "Este mensaje del SEÑOR vino a" (B); "Este es el mensaje que el SEÑOR le dio a" (R); "en los días de" (L), "durante el reinado de" (B), "cuando ... era rey" (R)
decisions.reason: The book heading follows the wording set for the Twelve and published in Hosea 1:1, which follows Jeremiah 1:1-2. Book-wide choices for Zephaniah in Spanish: YHWH is the divine_name span with its article inside it ("{{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}", "del SEÑOR|de Yahvé", "al SEÑOR|a Yahvé"); every plural "you", verbs included, takes a plural_you span; Zion and Jerusalem addressed as a woman take feminine "tú" (chapter 3); God's free pronouns take deity_pronoun spans, his "yo" none.

decisions.choice: "Sofonías hijo de Cusí, hijo de Gedalías, hijo de Amarías, hijo de Ezequías"; "Josías hijo de Amón"
decisions.reason: The published Spanish forms: Sofonías and Ezequías as in Kings, Cusí as in Jeremiah 36:14, Josías hijo de Amón as in 2 Kings 21-22. Readable gives the line of ancestors as a family line, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "La parole du SEIGNEUR qui fut adressée à Sophonie" (L), "La parole du SEIGNEUR fut adressée à Sophonie" (B), "Voici le message que le SEIGNEUR a donné à Sophonie" (R); "Sophonie fils de Koushi, fils de Guedalia, fils d'Amaria, fils d'Ézéchias"; "Josias fils d'Amon"
decisions.reason: The book heading follows the Twelve table and published Hosea 1:1 (as Jeremiah 1:1-2). The names are those of the terms sheet and the published Kings (Josias, Amon) and Jeremiah 36:14 (Koushi).

decisions.choice: Zephaniah's oracles are speech: present, future and passé composé at every level, never passé simple; only this heading takes the passé simple at L and B ("fut adressée") and the passé composé at R
decisions.reason: Everything after the heading is oracle or the prophet's poetry, which French treats as speech at every level, as in Joel and Amos. God's first-person pronouns and possessives take deity_pronoun spans ("{{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main"), "je" none; Jerusalem addressed as a woman in chapter 3 takes "tu" with feminine agreement.

decisions.choice: "Neno la BWANA lililomjia ... katika siku za" (L); "lilimjia ... wakati wa utawala wa" (B); "Huu ndio ujumbe ambao BWANA alimpa ... wakati ... alipokuwa mfalme" (R)
decisions.reason: The book heading follows the wording set for the Twelve and published in Hosea 1:1, as Jeremiah 1:1-2. In Swahili deity_pronoun spans go only on free pronouns and possessives (wangu, nami, yake), never on a verb prefix, so the Swahili has fewer spans than the English.

decisions.choice: "Sefania mwana wa Kushi, mwana wa Gedalia, mwana wa Amaria, mwana wa Hezekia"; "Yosia mwana wa Amoni"
decisions.reason: The names of the terms sheet and the published Kings (Yosia, Amoni, Hezekia) and Jeremiah 36:14 (Kushi).

decisions.choice: "Lời của CHÚA đã đến với ... trong đời" (L); "Lời CHÚA đến với ... dưới triều" (B); "Đây là sứ điệp CHÚA ban cho ... khi ... làm vua" (R)
decisions.reason: The book heading follows the wording set for the Twelve and published in Hosea 1:1, as Jeremiah 1:2. In the oracles God says "Ta" (spanned in mid-sentence) and speaks to Judah and the nations as "ngươi" / "các ngươi"; in the promises to Zion in 3:14-20 he says "con" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "Sô-phô-ni con trai Cút-si, cháu Ghê-đa-lia, chắt A-ma-ria, chít Ê-xê-chia" (B, R; L "con trai" each time); "Giô-si-a con trai A-môn"
decisions.reason: The terms sheet gives the father as "Cu-si", but the same Hebrew name is already published as "Cút-si" in Jeremiah 36:14, which the meaning decision m3 cites; the published form wins. Balanced uses the kinship words for grandson and further descendants, as the terms sheet sets; Literal repeats "con trai" as the Hebrew repeats "son".

decisions.choice: "…스바냐에게 임한 주의 말씀" (L); "주의 말씀이 … 스바냐에게 임했다" (B); "주께서 … 스바냐에게 주신 말씀이다" (R); "…의 시대에" (L), "…가 다스리던 때" (B), "…가 왕이었을 때" (R)
decisions.reason: The book heading follows the wording set for the Twelve and published in Hosea 1:1. Book-wide: God speaks in 해라체 with 나 and never takes -시- in his own mouth (so 주에게, not 주께, inside his speech); when the prophet speaks about him he takes -시- and 께서. Korean has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: "히스기야의 현손이요 아마랴의 증손이요 그다랴의 손자요 구시의 아들인 스바냐" (L, B); "아몬의 아들 요시야"
decisions.reason: Korean names a long line of ancestors from the furthest back, with the kinship words 현손, 증손, 손자, as Jeremiah 36:14 does for the same name 구시. The names are the terms sheet's and the published Kings forms.

source.text: אָסֹ֨ף אָסֵ֜ף כֹּ֗ל מֵעַ֛ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Utterly I will sweep away everything from upon [the] face of the ground, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: I will utterly sweep away everything from the face of the ground, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will sweep away everything, all that is on the face of the earth, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will completely sweep away everything on the earth, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Barreré por completo todo de sobre la faz del suelo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Barreré todas las cosas, todo cuanto hay sobre la faz de la tierra, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Barreré por completo todo lo que hay en la tierra, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Je balaierai entièrement tout de dessus la face du sol, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je balaierai tout, tout ce qui est sur la face de la terre, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je balaierai complètement tout ce qui est sur la terre, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nitafagilia mbali kabisa kila kitu kutoka juu ya uso wa ardhi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitafagilia mbali kila kitu, vyote vilivyo juu ya uso wa dunia, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitafagilia mbali kabisa kila kitu kilicho duniani, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ta sẽ quét sạch hết thảy mọi vật khỏi mặt đất, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Ta sẽ quét sạch mọi vật, tất cả những gì ở trên mặt đất, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Ta sẽ quét sạch hoàn toàn mọi thứ trên trái đất, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 내가 지면에서 모든 것을 반드시 쓸어 없애겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 내가 모든 것을, 땅 위에 있는 모든 것을 쓸어버리겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 내가 땅 위에 있는 모든 것을 완전히 쓸어버리겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: I will utterly sweep away: I will gather up and remove completely
decisions.reason: The Hebrew doubles the verb for emphasis, as if to say "I will sweep, sweep away". The two forms come from verbs that sound alike, one meaning "gather up, take away" and the other "come to an end", so the line also sounds like "I will make an end". The same verb is used for a harvest gathered in; here everything is gathered up to be removed. |

decisions.choice: the face of the ground: the whole surface of the earth where people and animals live
decisions.reason: The word for "ground" is the soil that humans are made from and farm. With the list of people, animals, birds and fish that follows (verse 3), the judgment here reaches all living things, as in the flood (Genesis 6:7). From verse 4 on it narrows to Judah and Jerusalem. |

decisions.choice: utterly sweep away (L); sweep away everything, all that is (B); completely sweep away (R); ground (L), earth (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "ground" for the Hebrew word and gives the doubled verb as "utterly". Balanced repeats "everything ... all that is" to give some of the doubled verb's force, and Balanced and Readable say "earth" because the whole world is meant (m2). |

decisions.choice: "declara el SEÑOR" (L), "afirma el SEÑOR" (B), "dice el SEÑOR" (R), after a comma
decisions.reason: The formula for ne'um YHWH set for the prophets, as published Isaiah and Amos, for the whole book. Literal says "suelo" for the Hebrew word for ground, which verse 3 plays on; Balanced and Readable say "tierra".

decisions.choice: "déclare le SEIGNEUR" (L, B), "dit le SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula for ne'um YHWH set for the prophets, for the whole book. Literal keeps "sol" for the Hebrew word for ground, which verse 3 plays on; Balanced and Readable say "terre".

decisions.choice: "asema BWANA" (L, B), "anasema BWANA" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula for ne'um YHWH set for the prophets, for the whole book. Literal says "ardhi" for the Hebrew word for ground; Balanced and Readable say "dunia", as the English says "earth".

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán vậy" (L, B), "CHÚA phán" (R); "Ta" for God
decisions.reason: The formula for ne'um YHWH set for the prophets, after a comma, for the whole book. God's "Ta" takes the deity_pronoun span in mid-sentence; at the start of a sentence it is written with its capital and no span.

decisions.choice: "주의 선언이다" (L); "주가 말한다" (B, R), as its own sentence
decisions.reason: The formula for ne'um YHWH set for the prophets (Isaiah, Amos), for the whole book. God names himself without -시- inside his own speech.

source.text: אָסֵ֨ף אָדָ֜ם וּבְהֵמָ֗ה אָסֵ֤ף עוֹף־הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֔ם וְהַמַּכְשֵׁל֖וֹת אֶת־הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים וְהִכְרַתִּ֣י אֶת־הָאָדָ֗ם מֵעַ֛ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away [the] birds of the heavens and [the] fish of the sea, and the stumbling blocks with the wicked; and I will cut off humankind from upon [the] face of the ground, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: I will sweep away human and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the heavens and the fish of the sea, \q and the stumbling blocks with the wicked; \q and I will cut off humankind from the face of the ground, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will sweep away people and animals; I will sweep away the birds of the sky and the fish of the sea, \q and the idols that make people fall, together with the wicked. \q I will cut off humankind from the face of the earth, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will sweep away people and animals, the birds in the sky and the fish in the sea. \q I will destroy the wicked and the idols that lead them into sin. \q I will wipe out the human race from the earth, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Barreré al ser humano y a la bestia; barreré las aves de los cielos y los peces del mar, \q y los tropiezos con los impíos; \q y cortaré a la humanidad de sobre la faz del suelo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Barreré a la gente y a los animales; barreré las aves del cielo y los peces del mar, \q y los ídolos que hacen caer a la gente, junto con los malvados. \q Eliminaré a la humanidad de la faz de la tierra, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Barreré a la gente y a los animales, a las aves del cielo y a los peces del mar. \q Destruiré a los malvados y a los ídolos que los llevan a pecar. \q Borraré a la raza humana de la tierra, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Je balaierai l’être humain et la bête ; je balaierai les oiseaux des cieux et les poissons de la mer, \q et les pierres d’achoppement avec les méchants ; \q et je retrancherai l’humanité de dessus la face du sol, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je balaierai les humains et les animaux ; je balaierai les oiseaux du ciel et les poissons de la mer, \q et les idoles qui font tomber les gens, avec les méchants. \q Je retrancherai l’humanité de la face de la terre, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je balaierai les humains et les animaux, les oiseaux du ciel et les poissons de la mer. \q Je détruirai les méchants et les idoles qui les entraînent au péché. \q J’effacerai le genre humain de la terre, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nitamfagilia mbali mwanadamu na mnyama; nitawafagilia mbali ndege wa angani na samaki wa baharini, \q na vikwazo pamoja na waovu; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawakatilia mbali wanadamu kutoka juu ya uso wa ardhi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitawafagilia mbali watu na wanyama; nitawafagilia mbali ndege wa angani na samaki wa baharini, \q na sanamu zinazowaangusha watu, pamoja na waovu. \q Nitawakatilia mbali wanadamu kutoka uso wa dunia, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitawafagilia mbali watu na wanyama, ndege wa angani na samaki wa baharini. \q Nitawaangamiza waovu na sanamu zinazowaongoza kutenda dhambi. \q Nitaifutilia mbali jamii ya wanadamu duniani, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ta sẽ quét sạch loài người và thú vật; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quét sạch chim trời và cá biển, \q cùng những vật gây vấp ngã với kẻ ác; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ diệt trừ loài người khỏi mặt đất, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Ta sẽ quét sạch người ta và thú vật; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quét sạch chim trời và cá biển, \q cùng các thần tượng khiến người ta vấp ngã, và cả kẻ ác nữa. \q Ta sẽ diệt trừ loài người khỏi mặt đất, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Ta sẽ quét sạch người và thú vật, chim trời và cá biển. \q Ta sẽ tiêu diệt kẻ ác và các thần tượng khiến chúng phạm tội. \q Ta sẽ xóa sạch loài người khỏi mặt đất, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 내가 사람과 짐승을 쓸어버리고, 하늘의 새와 바다의 물고기를 쓸어버리겠다. \q 걸려 넘어지게 하는 것들도 악인들과 함께 [쓸어버리겠다]. \q 내가 지면에서 인류를 끊어 버리겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 내가 사람과 짐승을 쓸어버리고, 하늘의 새와 바다의 물고기를 쓸어버리겠다. \q 사람들을 넘어지게 하는 우상들도 악인들과 함께 없애겠다. \q 내가 땅 위에서 인류를 끊어 버리겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 내가 사람과 짐승, 하늘의 새와 바다의 물고기를 쓸어버리겠다. \q 악한 사람들과 그들을 죄짓게 하는 우상들을 없애겠다. \q 내가 땅 위에서 인류를 쓸어 없애겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: humans, animals, birds and fish: creation undone
decisions.reason: The list names the living things of Genesis 1 in the reverse of the order in which they were made: humans and animals (day six), then birds and fish (day five). Like the flood (Genesis 6:7, which also speaks of "the face of the ground"), the judgment unmakes what God made. The poem uses the picture to show how complete the judgment will be. |

decisions.choice: the stumbling blocks with the wicked: the idols that make people fall, together with those who worship them
alternatives: the ruins, together with the wicked
a later note added to the text
decisions.reason: The phrase is hard. The word means something that makes people stumble; in Ezekiel 14:3-7 it is used for idols, which cause Israel to fall into sin, and that is the sense taken here. A related word means "ruin" (Isaiah 3:6), so some read "the ruins". The Greek translation is generally said not to have the phrase, and some think it was added as a comment on the verse.

decisions.choice: humankind ... the ground: a play on two related words
decisions.reason: The Hebrew words for "human beings" (adam) and "ground" (adamah) sound alike, recalling that the first human was formed from the ground (Genesis 2:7). The one taken from the ground is cut off from it. |

decisions.choice: the idols that make people fall (B); the idols that lead them into sin (R); stumbling blocks (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "stumbling blocks". Balanced and Readable say what the stumbling blocks are taken to be (m2); the footnote gives the other reading. "Humankind" (L, B) and "the human race" (R) already include men and women.

decisions.choice: "al ser humano" (L); "la humanidad" (L, B), "la raza humana" (R); no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish says "ser humano" and "humanidad", which already include women and men, as the English "human" and "humankind" do, so no gender setting is needed. Literal keeps "suelo" for ground, as in verse 2, so that the play between adam and adamah (m3) can still be seen.

decisions.choice: "l'être humain" (L), "les humains" (B, R); "l'humanité" (L, B), "le genre humain" (R); no gender span
decisions.reason: These French words already include women and men, as the English does, so no gender setting is needed. "Pierres d'achoppement" at Literal keeps the picture of stumbling; Balanced and Readable say what they are taken to be (m2).

decisions.choice: "nami" spanned; "mwanadamu", "wanadamu" with no gender span
decisions.reason: God's free pronoun "nami" (and I) takes the deity_pronoun span; the verb prefixes do not. "Mwanadamu" and "wanadamu" already include women and men. Literal says "vikwazo" (stumbling blocks) and Balanced and Readable say "sanamu" (idols), as the English does (m2).

decisions.choice: "걸려 넘어지게 하는 것들" (L); "사람들을 넘어지게 하는 우상들" (B); "그들을 죄짓게 하는 우상들" (R)
decisions.reason: Korean needs a verb for the list in the second line; Literal supplies the verb of the first line in brackets. Balanced and Readable say what the stumbling blocks are taken to be (m2).

source.text: וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עַל־יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל כָּל־יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֞י מִן־הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ אֶת־שְׁאָ֣ר הַבַּ֔עַל אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם הַכְּמָרִ֖ים עִם־הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off from this place the remnant of Baal, the name of the idol-priests with the priests,

en.L: And I will stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against Judah \q and against everyone who dwells in Jerusalem; \q and I will cut off from this place the remnant of Baal, \q the name of the idol-priests with the priests,
en.B: I will stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against Judah \q and against everyone who lives in Jerusalem. \q From this place I will cut off every trace of Baal, \q the very name of the idol-priests along with the priests,
en.R: I will punish Judah \q and all the people who live in Jerusalem. \q I will remove from this place every last trace of Baal worship. \q Even the names of the priests who serve idols will be forgotten, and the priests who join them.

es.L: Y extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra Judá \q y contra todos los habitantes de Jerusalén; \q y cortaré de este lugar el remanente de Baal, \q el nombre de los sacerdotes idólatras junto con los sacerdotes,
es.B: Extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra Judá \q y contra todos los que viven en Jerusalén. \q De este lugar eliminaré todo rastro de Baal, \q hasta el nombre de los sacerdotes idólatras junto con los sacerdotes,
es.R: Castigaré a Judá \q y a toda la gente que vive en Jerusalén. \q Quitaré de este lugar hasta el último rastro del culto a Baal. \q Hasta los nombres de los sacerdotes que sirven a los ídolos serán olvidados, y los de los sacerdotes que se unen a ellos.

fr.L: Et j’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre Juda \q et contre tous les habitants de Jérusalem ; \q et je retrancherai de ce lieu le reste de Baal, \q le nom des prêtres des idoles avec les prêtres,
fr.B: J’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre Juda \q et contre tous ceux qui habitent Jérusalem. \q De ce lieu je retrancherai toute trace de Baal, \q jusqu’au nom des prêtres des idoles, avec les prêtres,
fr.R: Je punirai Juda \q et tous les habitants de Jérusalem. \q J’enlèverai de ce lieu jusqu’à la dernière trace du culte de Baal. \q Même les noms des prêtres qui servent les idoles seront oubliés, et ceux des prêtres qui se joignent à eux.

sw.L: Nami nitanyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya Yuda \q na juu ya wakaaji wote wa Yerusalemu; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakatilia mbali kutoka mahali hapa mabaki ya Baali, \q jina la makuhani wa sanamu pamoja na makuhani,
sw.B: Nitanyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya Yuda \q na juu ya wote wanaoishi Yerusalemu. \q Kutoka mahali hapa nitakatilia mbali kila alama ya Baali, \q hata jina la makuhani wa sanamu pamoja na makuhani,
sw.R: Nitaiadhibu Yuda \q na watu wote wanaoishi Yerusalemu. \q Nitaondoa mahali hapa dalili ya mwisho ya ibada ya Baali. \q Hata majina ya makuhani wanaotumikia sanamu yatasahauliwa, pamoja na makuhani wanaoungana nao.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giơ tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra nghịch cùng Giu-đa \q và nghịch cùng mọi cư dân Giê-ru-sa-lem; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ diệt trừ khỏi nơi này phần sót lại của Ba-anh, \q danh của các thầy tế lễ thần tượng cùng với các thầy tế lễ.
vi.B: Ta sẽ giơ tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra nghịch cùng Giu-đa \q và nghịch cùng mọi người sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Khỏi nơi này {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ diệt trừ mọi dấu vết của Ba-anh, \q cả danh của các thầy tế lễ thần tượng lẫn các thầy tế lễ.
vi.R: Ta sẽ trừng phạt Giu-đa \q và mọi người sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Ta sẽ dẹp bỏ khỏi nơi này đến dấu vết cuối cùng của việc thờ Ba-anh. \q Ngay cả tên của các thầy tế lễ phục vụ thần tượng cũng sẽ bị quên lãng, cùng với các thầy tế lễ theo họ.

ko.L: 내가 유다 위에, \q 예루살렘의 모든 주민 위에 내 손을 뻗겠다. \q 내가 이곳에서 바알의 남은 것을, \q 우상 제사장들의 이름을 제사장들과 함께 끊어 버리겠다.
ko.B: 내가 유다를 치려고 손을 뻗고, \q 예루살렘에 사는 모든 사람을 치겠다. \q 이곳에서 바알의 흔적을 모두 끊어 버리고, \q 우상을 섬기는 제사장들과 그들과 함께한 제사장들의 이름까지 없애겠다.
ko.R: 내가 유다와 \q 예루살렘에 사는 모든 사람을 벌하겠다. \q 이곳에서 바알 숭배의 마지막 흔적까지 없애겠다. \q 우상을 섬기는 제사장들과 그들과 한패가 된 제사장들의 이름조차 잊히게 하겠다.

decisions.choice: stretch out my hand against: act in power to punish
decisions.reason: The outstretched hand of the LORD is his power at work, as when he struck Egypt (Exodus 7:5). In Isaiah his hand is "stretched out still" against his own people (Isaiah 5:25; 9:11). The judgment of the whole world in verses 2-3 now turns on Judah and Jerusalem. |

decisions.choice: the remnant of Baal: whatever is left of the worship of Baal
alternatives: the last survivors of Baal's worshipers
decisions.reason: "Remnant" is what remains of something. Here it means the last trace of Baal worship in Jerusalem, "this place". If the verse comes from the time of Josiah's purge (2 Kings 23:4-5), some of that worship was already gone and the LORD will finish it. |

decisions.choice: the idol-priests with the priests: priests of foreign gods, together with priests who joined them
decisions.reason: The first word is used only of priests who served idols (2 Kings 23:5; Hosea 10:5). The second is the usual word for priests, and here probably means priests of the LORD who took part in the same worship. To cut off someone's name is to wipe out even their memory. |

decisions.choice: idol-priests (L, B); the priests who serve idols (R)
decisions.reason: The wording follows Hosea 10:5 and 2 Kings 23:5. Readable says "I will punish" for "stretch out my hand against" (m1) and makes the cutting off of the name plain: the names will be forgotten. |

decisions.choice: "sacerdotes idólatras" (L, B); "los sacerdotes que sirven a los ídolos" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording published for the same word in Hosea 10:5 and 2 Kings 23:5.

decisions.choice: "prêtres des idoles" (L, B); "les prêtres qui servent les idoles" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording published for the same word in Hosea 10:5 and 2 Kings 23:5.

decisions.choice: "makuhani wa sanamu"; "mabaki ya Baali" (L), "kila alama ya Baali" (B)
decisions.reason: The wording published for the same word in 2 Kings 23:5. Literal keeps "mabaki" (remnant); Balanced says "every trace", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "các thầy tế lễ thần tượng" (L, B); "các thầy tế lễ phục vụ thần tượng" (R)
decisions.reason: Close to the published 2 Kings 23:5 ("các thầy tế lễ thờ thần tượng"), kept short in the poem's line.

decisions.choice: verses 4, 5 and 6 each close as their own sentence; verses 5 and 6 open with "[Ta cũng sẽ diệt trừ]" (L) / "Ta cũng sẽ diệt trừ" (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew lists the groups of verses 4-6 as objects of one verb. Vietnamese closes each verse as its own sentence (the Psalms rule for these books), so verses 5 and 6 repeat the verb, in brackets at Literal, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Each of verses 4, 5 and 6 ends with its own verb (끊어 버리겠다, [끊어 버리겠다] in L; 없애겠다 in B and R)
decisions.reason: Hebrew lists the groups of verses 4-6 as objects of one verb. Korean puts the verb last, so to keep each verse's own content after its marker, each verse closes its sentence; Literal brackets the repeated verb in verses 5 and 6.

source.text: וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁתַּחֲוִ֥ים עַל־הַגַּגּ֖וֹת לִצְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְאֶת־הַמִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוִים֙ הַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֣ים לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֖ים בְּמַלְכָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and those who bow down on the roofs to the host of the heavens, and those who bow down, who swear to Yahweh and who swear by their king,

en.L: and those who bow down on the roofs to the host of the heavens, \q and those who bow down, who swear to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q and swear by their king,
en.B: those who bow down on the rooftops to the host of heaven, \q and those who bow down and swear by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q while they also swear by their king,
en.R: I will destroy those who bow down on their roofs to worship the stars in the sky. \q I will destroy those who bow down and make promises in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q but also make promises in the name of the god they call their king.

es.L: y a los que se postran sobre los terrados ante el ejército de los cielos, \q y a los que se postran, que juran {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} \q y juran por su rey,
es.B: a los que se postran en las azoteas ante el ejército del cielo, \q y a los que se postran y juran por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} \q mientras juran también por su rey,
es.R: Destruiré a los que se inclinan en sus azoteas para adorar a las estrellas del cielo. \q Destruiré a los que se inclinan y hacen promesas en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q pero también hacen promesas en el nombre del dios al que llaman su rey.

fr.L: et ceux qui se prosternent sur les toits devant l’armée des cieux, \q et ceux qui se prosternent, qui font serment {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} \q et jurent par leur roi,
fr.B: ceux qui se prosternent sur les terrasses devant l’armée du ciel, \q et ceux qui se prosternent et jurent par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} \q tout en jurant aussi par leur roi,
fr.R: Je détruirai ceux qui se prosternent sur leurs toits pour adorer les étoiles du ciel. \q Je détruirai ceux qui se prosternent et font des promesses au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q mais qui font aussi des promesses au nom du dieu qu’ils appellent leur roi.

sw.L: na wale wanaosujudu juu ya dari kwa jeshi la mbinguni, \q na wale wanaosujudu, wanaoapa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q na kuapa kwa mfalme wao,
sw.B: wale wanaosujudu juu ya paa za nyumba kwa jeshi la mbinguni, \q na wale wanaosujudu na kuapa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q huku wakiapa pia kwa mfalme wao,
sw.R: Nitawaangamiza wale wanaoinama juu ya paa za nyumba zao kuabudu nyota za angani. \q Nitawaangamiza wale wanaoinama na kuweka ahadi kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q lakini pia wanaweka ahadi kwa jina la mungu wanayemwita mfalme wao.

vi.L: [Ta cũng sẽ diệt trừ] những kẻ trên mái nhà cúi lạy cơ binh trên trời, \q và những kẻ cúi lạy, thề với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} \q mà cũng thề nhân danh vua của chúng.
vi.B: Ta cũng sẽ diệt trừ những kẻ trên sân thượng cúi lạy cơ binh trên trời, \q và những kẻ cúi lạy và thề nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} \q trong khi cũng thề nhân danh vua của chúng.
vi.R: Ta sẽ tiêu diệt những kẻ lên mái nhà cúi lạy các ngôi sao trên trời. \q Ta sẽ tiêu diệt những kẻ cúi lạy và hứa nguyện nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q nhưng cũng hứa nguyện nhân danh vị thần mà chúng gọi là vua của mình.

ko.L: 또 지붕 위에서 하늘의 군대에게 절하는 자들과, \q 절하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 맹세하면서 \q 그들의 왕을 두고도 맹세하는 자들을 [끊어 버리겠다].
ko.B: 지붕 위에서 하늘의 별들에게 절하는 자들과, \q 절하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두고 맹세하면서도 \q 그들의 왕을 두고 맹세하는 자들도 없애겠다.
ko.R: 지붕에 올라가 하늘의 별들에게 절하는 자들을 없애겠다. \q 절하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 약속하면서도, \q 자기들이 왕이라고 부르는 신의 이름으로도 약속하는 자들을 없애겠다.

decisions.choice: worship of the host of heaven on the roofs
decisions.reason: The host of heaven is the sun, moon and stars, worshiped as gods. Flat roofs served as places of worship where the sky could be seen, and people burned incense and poured offerings there (2 Kings 23:12; Jeremiah 19:13; 32:29). Josiah's purge removed this worship (2 Kings 23:5). |

decisions.choice: by their king: by the god they honor as king, perhaps Milcom
decisions.reason: The Hebrew letters can be read "their king" or "Milcom", the god of the Ammonites (1 Kings 11:5, 33; Jeremiah 49:1). The standard Hebrew text reads "their king", and the Greek and Latin traditions are generally said to support Milcom in some copies. Either way the "king" is a god other than the LORD; "king" is also the meaning of the name Molech.

decisions.choice: swear to the LORD and swear by their king: divided loyalty
decisions.reason: To swear by a god is to call on him as witness and to acknowledge his authority. These people bow to the LORD and still keep another god, the half-loyalty Elijah condemned (1 Kings 18:21). Zephaniah lists three groups in verses 4-6: the open idolaters, those who serve the LORD and other gods together, and those who have turned away from the LORD altogether. |

decisions.choice: the host of the heavens (L), the host of heaven (B), the stars in the sky (R); their king at every level
decisions.reason: "The host of heaven" follows Jeremiah 19:13 and 2 Kings 23:5. "Their king" follows the Hebrew text at every level; Readable adds "the god they call" so that the reader knows that a god is meant, which the verse implies (m2). Readable repeats "I will destroy" from verse 4 to make each group its own sentence. |

decisions.choice: "el ejército de los cielos" (L), "el ejército del cielo" (B), "las estrellas del cielo" (R); "su rey" at L and B
decisions.reason: "El ejército de los cielos" is the wording published in 2 Kings 23:5. "Su rey" follows the Hebrew text at every level, as the English does; Readable says "el dios al que llaman su rey" (m2).

decisions.choice: "l'armée des cieux" (L), "l'armée du ciel" (B), "les étoiles du ciel" (R); "qui font serment au SEIGNEUR" (L)
decisions.reason: "L'armée des cieux" is the wording published in 2 Kings 23:5. Literal says "faire serment au SEIGNEUR" for the Hebrew "swear to" the LORD, and keeps "jurer par" for "swear by their king".

decisions.choice: "cơ binh trên trời" (L, B), "các ngôi sao trên trời" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording published in 2 Kings 23:5 for the host of heaven. "Chúng" for the guilty, as the oracles do.

decisions.choice: "주에게 맹세하면서" (L), not "주께"
decisions.reason: Inside God's own speech his name takes no honorific particle 께, as the terms sheet sets for the prophets. Literal says "하늘의 군대" for the host of heaven, and Balanced and Readable "하늘의 별들", as published 2 Kings 23:5.

source.text: וְאֶת־הַנְּסוֹגִ֖ים מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַאֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־בִקְשׁ֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א דְרָשֻֽׁהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: and those who turn back from after Yahweh, and who have not sought Yahweh and not inquired of him.

en.L: and those who turn back from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and who have not sought {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} or inquired of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: and those who have turned away from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q who do not seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} or ask for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} guidance.
en.R: I will destroy those who have stopped following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q and do not come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} or ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for help.

ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따르다가 등을 돌린 자들과, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾지도 않고 그의 인도를 구하지도 않는 자들도 없애겠다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따르기를 그만두고, \q 그에게 나아오지도 않고 도움을 구하지도 않는 자들을 없애겠다.

decisions.choice: seek the LORD, inquire of him: turn to him in worship and prayer, and ask his guidance
decisions.reason: To seek the LORD is to come to him in worship and to live by his will (Amos 5:4-6; Hosea 10:12). To inquire of him is to ask him for guidance, often through a prophet or priest. The last group in verses 4-6 have not taken up other gods; they simply live as if the LORD did not matter. Verse 12 describes their attitude. |

decisions.choice: turn back from following the LORD: give up being his followers
decisions.reason: To walk "after" someone is to follow him as a servant follows his master or worshipers follow a god (Jeremiah 2:5). These people once followed the LORD and have turned their backs. |

decisions.choice: ask for his guidance (B); ask him for help (R)
decisions.reason: "Inquire of" is old-fashioned; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1). |

decisions.choice: "그에게", "그의" for the LORD, without -시-
decisions.reason: The LORD is still the speaker (verse 4, "I will"), speaking of himself in the third person, so Korean gives him no honorific, as God never takes -시- in his own mouth.

records.literal_gloss: Hush before [the] Lord Yahweh, for near [is the] day of Yahweh; for Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice; he has consecrated his invited [ones].

en.L: Hush before the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, \q for near [is] the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has prepared a sacrifice; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has consecrated {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} guests.
en.B: Be silent before the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, \q for the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is close at hand. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has prepared a sacrifice; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has set apart the guests {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} invited.
en.R: Be quiet in the presence of the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, \q because the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is near. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has prepared a sacrifice, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has chosen {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} guests and made them ready.

es.L: Silencio ante el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, \q porque cerca [está] el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha preparado un sacrificio; \q ha consagrado a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} invitados.
es.B: Que todos callen ante el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, \q porque el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está cerca. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha preparado un sacrificio; \q ha apartado a los invitados que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} convocó.
es.R: {{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} callados ante el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, \q porque el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está cerca. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha preparado un sacrificio, \q y ha escogido a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} invitados y los ha preparado.

fr.L: Silence devant le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, \q car il est proche, le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a préparé un sacrifice ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a consacré {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} invités.
fr.B: Faites silence devant le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, \q car le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est tout proche. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a préparé un sacrifice ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mis à part les invités qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a conviés.
fr.R: Taisez-vous devant le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, \q car le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est proche. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a préparé un sacrifice, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} invités et les a préparés.

sw.L: Kimya mbele za Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, \q kwa maana siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [i] karibu; \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameandaa dhabihu; \q amewatakasa wageni {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Nyamazeni mbele za Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, \q kwa maana siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} imekaribia. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameandaa dhabihu; \q amewatenga wageni aliowaalika.
sw.R: Kaeni kimya mbele za Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, \q kwa sababu siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} iko karibu. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameandaa dhabihu, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} amewachagua wageni {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kuwaweka tayari.

vi.L: Hãy im lặng trước mặt Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q vì ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã gần; \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sửa soạn một sinh tế; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thánh hóa các khách mời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy lặng thinh trước mặt Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q vì ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã gần kề. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chuẩn bị một sinh tế; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã biệt riêng những khách {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã mời.
vi.R: Hãy yên lặng trước mặt Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q vì ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã gần. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chuẩn bị một sinh tế, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn khách của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và làm cho họ sẵn sàng.

ko.L: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}} 앞에서 잠잠하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 가깝기 때문이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 희생 제물을 준비하시고, \q 그분께서 초대하신 자들을 거룩하게 하셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}} 앞에서 조용히 하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 가까이 왔다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 희생 제물을 준비하시고, \q 초대하신 손님들을 구별해 두셨다.
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}} 앞에서 조용히 있어라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 가까이 왔다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 희생 제물을 준비하셨고, \q 손님들을 골라 준비시키셨다.

decisions.choice: Hush: be silent in awe, because the LORD is about to act
decisions.reason: The word is a call for silence, like "Hush!". People fall silent before a judge or a king who has come to act (Habakkuk 2:20; Zechariah 2:17; Amos 6:10). |

decisions.choice: for near is the day of the LORD: the words of Isaiah 13:6 and Joel 1:15
decisions.reason: "Near is the day of the LORD" is found word for word in Isaiah 13:6, Joel 1:15 and Obadiah 15, and again in verse 14. The day of the LORD is the day when the LORD comes to act in judgment, and to rescue; see the note at Joel 1:15. |

decisions.choice: the LORD's sacrifice: Judah itself is the sacrifice, and the guests are the nations invited to the slaughter
decisions.reason: A sacrifice was often followed by a meal for invited guests, who first made themselves ritually clean (1 Samuel 9:13; 16:5). Here the picture is turned around: the victims are the people of Judah, and the guests are the enemies the LORD summons to carry out his judgment. Isaiah 34:6, Jeremiah 46:10 and Ezekiel 39:17-20 use the same picture of a slaughter as a sacrifice. The poem does not name the guests. |

decisions.choice: consecrated: made holy, made ready to take part
decisions.reason: The verb means "make holy". Guests at a sacrifice were consecrated to take part in it (1 Samuel 16:5). The same verb is used of armies made ready for a holy war (Jeremiah 6:4; Isaiah 13:3, where the LORD calls them "my consecrated ones"). |

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 13:6 at each level; Hush (L), Be silent (B), Be quiet (R)
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats the words of Isaiah 13:6 and Joel 1:15, each level uses the wording already published there: "near [is] the day of the LORD" (L), "is close at hand" (B), "is near" (R). "The Lord GOD" follows the table for the divine name with "Lord". Balanced and Readable spell out "his invited ones" as the guests he invited or chose. |

decisions.choice: "cerca [está] el día del SEÑOR" (L); "el día del SEÑOR está cerca" (B, R); "el Señor DIOS"
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats Isaiah 13:6, each level uses the Spanish published there. "The Lord GOD" is "el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}", with the article outside the span. Readable's command to be quiet is plural, with plural_you.

decisions.choice: "il est proche, le jour du SEIGNEUR" (L); "est tout proche" (B); "est proche" (R); "le Seigneur DIEU"
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats Isaiah 13:6, each level uses the French published there. "The Lord GOD" is "le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}", the span holding only DIEU.

decisions.choice: "siku ya BWANA [i] karibu" (L); "imekaribia" (B); "iko karibu" (R); "Bwana MUNGU"
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats Isaiah 13:6, each level uses the Swahili published there. "The Lord GOD" is "Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}", the span on MUNGU only.

decisions.choice: "ngày của CHÚA đã gần" (L, R), "đã gần kề" (B); "Chúa là CHÚA"
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats Isaiah 13:6, each level uses the Vietnamese published there. "The Lord GOD" is "Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}", with "Chúa" outside the span.

decisions.choice: "주의 날이 가깝다" (L), "가까이 왔다" (B, R), as Isaiah 13:6; "주 하나님" with only particles that fit both forms
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats Isaiah 13:6, each level uses the Korean published there. "The Lord GOD" is "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}", and only particles that read after both 하나님 and 야훼 follow it (앞에서 here). The prophet speaks about the LORD, so he takes -시- and 께서.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּיוֹם֙ זֶ֣בַח יְהוָ֔ה וּפָקַדְתִּ֥י עַל־הַשָּׂרִ֖ים וְעַל־בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְעַ֥ל כָּל־הַלֹּבְשִׁ֖ים מַלְבּ֥וּשׁ נָכְרִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on [the] day of [the] sacrifice of Yahweh, and I will punish the officials and the sons of the king, and all who clothe themselves [in] foreign clothing.

en.L: And it will be on the day of the sacrifice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q that I will punish the officials and the sons of the king, \q and all who clothe themselves in foreign clothing.
en.B: On the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s sacrifice \q I will punish the officials and the king's sons, \q and all who dress in foreign clothes.
en.R: On the day when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} offers this sacrifice, \q I will punish the leaders and the king's sons \q and everyone who dresses like foreigners.

es.L: Y sucederá en el día del sacrificio {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} \q que castigaré a los príncipes y a los hijos del rey, \q y a todos los que se visten con ropa extranjera.
es.B: En el día del sacrificio {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} \q castigaré a los jefes y a los hijos del rey, \q y a todos los que se visten con ropas extranjeras.
es.R: El día en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ofrezca este sacrificio, \q castigaré a los dirigentes y a los hijos del rey \q y a todos los que se visten como extranjeros.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, au jour du sacrifice {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q que je punirai les chefs et les fils du roi, \q et tous ceux qui se revêtent d’un vêtement étranger.
fr.B: Au jour du sacrifice {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q je punirai les chefs et les fils du roi, \q et tous ceux qui portent des vêtements étrangers.
fr.R: Le jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} offrira ce sacrifice, \q je punirai les dirigeants et les fils du roi \q et tous ceux qui s’habillent comme des étrangers.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ya dhabihu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q kwamba nitawaadhibu maafisa na wana wa mfalme, \q na wote wanaojivika mavazi ya kigeni.
sw.B: Katika siku ya dhabihu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q nitawaadhibu maafisa na wana wa mfalme, \q na wote wanaovaa mavazi ya kigeni.
sw.R: Siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakapotoa dhabihu hii, \q nitawaadhibu viongozi na wana wa mfalme \q na kila mtu anayevaa kama wageni.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra trong ngày sinh tế của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt các quan chức và các con trai của vua, \q cùng mọi kẻ mặc y phục ngoại bang.
vi.B: Trong ngày sinh tế của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt các quan chức và các hoàng tử, \q cùng mọi kẻ ăn mặc theo kiểu ngoại bang.
vi.R: Vào ngày {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dâng sinh tế này, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt những người lãnh đạo và các hoàng tử \q cùng mọi kẻ ăn mặc như người nước ngoài.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 희생 제물의 날이 되면 \q 내가 고관들과 왕의 아들들을 벌하고, \q 이방 옷을 입은 모든 자를 벌하겠다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 희생 제물의 날에 \q 내가 관리들과 왕자들과 \q 이방 옷을 입은 자들을 모두 벌하겠다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 이 희생 제물을 잡는 날에, \q 나는 지도자들과 왕자들과 \q 외국 사람처럼 옷을 입은 자들을 모두 벌하겠다.

decisions.choice: I will punish: I will call to account
decisions.reason: The verb means to visit, inspect or attend to. With "on" a person it means to call him to account and punish him, as again in verses 9 and 12. |

decisions.choice: the officials and the sons of the king: the leaders of the court and the royal family
decisions.reason: The king himself is not named. Josiah came to the throne at eight years old (2 Kings 22:1), and the officials who ran the kingdom, with the royal princes, were the ones who shaped its life. Judgment begins with those who lead. |

decisions.choice: foreign clothing: dress taken from other nations, perhaps for their worship
decisions.reason: Clothes showed which people, and which god, one belonged to. Worshipers of Baal wore special robes (2 Kings 10:22). Foreign dress may mean the garments of foreign worship, or a wider taking over of foreign ways by Judah's leaders. Either way it marks loyalty given away from the LORD.

decisions.choice: officials (L, B); leaders (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the one settled for court officials in the Twelve. Readable says "everyone who dresses like foreigners" for "clothe themselves in foreign clothing". |

decisions.choice: "los príncipes" (L), "los jefes" (B), "los dirigentes" (R)
decisions.reason: Sarim keep the words of the Spanish prophets (Jeremiah, Amos 1:15), against the English "officials" at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: "les chefs" (L, B), "les dirigeants" (R)
decisions.reason: Sarim as the Twelve table and published Amos 1:15.

decisions.choice: "maafisa" (L, B), "viongozi" (R)
decisions.reason: Sarim as published Amos 1:15 and Jeremiah 36.

decisions.choice: "các quan chức" (L, B), "những người lãnh đạo" (R); "các hoàng tử" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Sarim as published Amos 1:15. Literal keeps "các con trai của vua"; Balanced and Readable use the ordinary word for the king's sons.

decisions.choice: "고관들" (L), "관리들" (B), "지도자들" (R)
decisions.reason: Sarim as the terms sheet and published Amos 1:15. The LORD speaks of his own sacrifice, so his name takes no honorific.

source.text: וּפָקַדְתִּ֗י עַ֧ל כָּל־הַדּוֹלֵ֛ג עַל־הַמִּפְתָּ֖ן בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא הַֽמְמַלְאִ֛ים בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֵיהֶ֖ם חָמָ֥ס וּמִרְמָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will punish every [one] who leaps over the threshold in that day, who fill the house of their master [with] violence and deceit.

en.L: And I will punish everyone who leaps over the threshold in that day, \q who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit.
en.B: On that day I will punish all who leap across the threshold, \q and who fill their master's house with violence and deceit.
en.R: At that time I will punish all who jump over the doorstep, \q who fill their master's house with what they have taken by violence and lies.

es.L: Y castigaré en aquel día a todo el que salta sobre el umbral, \q a los que llenan la casa de su señor de violencia y engaño.
es.B: Aquel día castigaré a todos los que saltan por encima del umbral, \q y a los que llenan la casa de su señor de violencia y de engaño.
es.R: En ese tiempo castigaré a todos los que saltan por encima de la entrada, \q que llenan la casa de su amo con lo que roban con violencia y mentiras.

fr.L: Et je punirai, en ce jour-là, quiconque saute par-dessus le seuil, \q ceux qui remplissent la maison de leur maître de violence et de tromperie.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, je punirai tous ceux qui sautent par-dessus le seuil, \q et qui remplissent la maison de leur maître de violence et de fraude.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je punirai tous ceux qui sautent par-dessus le pas de la porte, \q et qui remplissent la maison de leur maître de ce qu’ils ont pris par la violence et le mensonge.

sw.L: Nami nitamwadhibu katika siku ile kila arukaye juu ya kizingiti, \q wale wanaoijaza nyumba ya bwana wao jeuri na udanganyifu.
sw.B: Siku hiyo nitawaadhibu wote wanaoruka juu ya kizingiti, \q wanaoijaza nyumba ya bwana wao jeuri na udanganyifu.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitawaadhibu wote wanaoruka juu ya kizingiti cha mlango, \q wanaoijaza nyumba ya bwana wao vitu walivyonyang'anya kwa jeuri na uongo.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt mọi kẻ nhảy qua ngưỡng cửa trong ngày ấy, \q những kẻ làm cho nhà chủ mình đầy dẫy bạo lực và gian dối.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt tất cả những kẻ nhảy qua ngưỡng cửa, \q và làm cho nhà chủ mình đầy bạo lực và gian dối.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt tất cả những kẻ nhảy qua bậc cửa, \q những kẻ chất đầy nhà chủ mình bằng của cải cướp được nhờ bạo lực và dối trá.

ko.L: 그날에 내가 문지방을 뛰어넘는 자들, \q 곧 자기 주인의 집을 폭력과 속임수로 채우는 자들을 모두 벌하겠다.
ko.B: 그날에 나는 문지방을 뛰어넘는 자들과 \q 자기 주인의 집을 폭력과 속임수로 가득 채우는 자들을 모두 벌하겠다.
ko.R: 그때에 나는 문간을 뛰어넘는 자들을 모두 벌하겠다. \q 그들은 폭력과 거짓말로 빼앗은 것으로 자기 주인의 집을 채운다.

decisions.choice: who leaps over the threshold: a practice of foreign worship, or a forced entry
alternatives: those who climb onto the platform
those who burst into houses to rob them
decisions.reason: When the idol of Dagon fell on its threshold, his priests began to avoid stepping on it (1 Samuel 5:5). Leaping over the threshold may be a custom like that, taken over from foreign worship, which fits verse 8. The word may also mean a raised platform, or the verse may picture servants rushing through doors to seize goods for their master, which fits the second half of the verse. The text does not settle it.

decisions.choice: their master: their lord, the king or the god they serve
decisions.reason: The word is plural in form, which Hebrew uses for one master and for God. It may be the king, whose palace his servants fill with plunder, or a god, whose temple is filled. The first fits the verse best.

decisions.choice: fill with violence and deceit: fill with goods gained by violence and fraud
decisions.reason: Amos 3:10 speaks of those who "store up violence and robbery in their fortresses", and Jeremiah 5:27 of houses "full of deceit". What is meant is the plunder itself, named by the way it was gained. |

decisions.choice: with what they have taken by violence and lies (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what fills the house (m3). |

decisions.choice: in that day (L), on that day (B), at that time (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase follows the Isaiah table, here and in verse 10. |

decisions.reason: The wording set for "in that day" in the prophets, here and in verse 10 and 3:11, 16.

decisions.reason: The wording set for "in that day" in the prophets, here and in verse 10 and 3:11, 16.

decisions.reason: The wording set for "in that day" in the prophets, here and in verse 10 and 3:11, 16. "Nami" at the start of the sentence is written plainly, without a span.

decisions.choice: "trong ngày ấy" (L), "vào ngày ấy" (B), "vào lúc ấy" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for "in that day" in the prophets, here and in verse 10 and 3:11, 16.
