decisions.reason: The wording set for "in that day" in the prophets, here and in verse 10 and 3:11, 16.

source.text: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־יְהוָ֗ה ק֤וֹל צְעָקָה֙ מִשַּׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֔ים וִֽילָלָ֖ה מִן־הַמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל מֵהַגְּבָעֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in that day, declaration of Yahweh, [the] sound of a cry from the Fish Gate, and wailing from the Second [Quarter], and a great crash from the hills.

en.L: And it will be in that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the sound of a cry from the Fish Gate, \q and wailing from the Second Quarter, \q and a great crash from the hills.
en.B: On that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, a cry will rise from the Fish Gate, \q wailing from the Second Quarter, \q and a loud crash from the hills.
en.R: At that time, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, people will cry out at the Fish Gate. \q They will wail in the Second Quarter, the newer part of the city. \q A loud crashing sound will come from the hills.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [que se oirá] el sonido de un grito desde la puerta del Pescado, \q y gemido desde el Segundo Barrio, \q y gran estruendo desde las colinas.
es.B: Aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, se oirá un grito desde la puerta del Pescado, \q gemidos desde el Segundo Barrio \q y un gran estruendo desde las colinas.
es.R: En ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, la gente gritará en la puerta del Pescado. \q Habrá llanto en el Segundo Barrio, la parte nueva de la ciudad. \q Desde las colinas llegará un gran estruendo.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [qu’on entendra] le bruit d’un cri depuis la porte des Poissons, \q et une lamentation depuis le second quartier, \q et un grand fracas depuis les collines.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, un cri s’élèvera de la porte des Poissons, \q des lamentations, du second quartier, \q et un grand fracas, des collines.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, les gens crieront à la porte des Poissons. \q On se lamentera dans le second quartier, la partie nouvelle de la ville. \q Un grand bruit d’écroulement viendra des collines.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sauti ya kilio kutoka Lango la Samaki, \q na maombolezo kutoka Mtaa wa Pili, \q na kishindo kikuu kutoka vilimani.
sw.B: Siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kilio kitasikika kutoka Lango la Samaki, \q maombolezo kutoka Mtaa wa Pili, \q na kishindo kikubwa kutoka vilimani.
sw.R: Wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu watalia kwenye Lango la Samaki. \q Wataomboleza katika Mtaa wa Pili, sehemu mpya ya mji. \q Kishindo kikubwa kitasikika kutoka vilimani.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, [sẽ có] tiếng kêu la từ Cổng Cá, \q và tiếng than khóc từ Khu Thứ Hai, \q và tiếng đổ vỡ lớn từ các đồi.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, sẽ có tiếng kêu la từ Cổng Cá, \q tiếng than khóc từ Khu Thứ Hai, \q và tiếng đổ vỡ ầm ầm từ các ngọn đồi.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, người ta sẽ kêu la tại Cổng Cá. \q Họ sẽ than khóc tại Khu Thứ Hai, là khu mới của thành. \q Một tiếng đổ vỡ lớn sẽ vang lên từ các ngọn đồi.

ko.L: 그날에 물고기 문에서 부르짖는 소리가, \q 둘째 구역에서 울부짖는 소리가, \q 언덕들에서 크게 무너지는 소리가 [날 것이다]. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 그날에 물고기 문에서 부르짖는 소리가 나고, \q 둘째 구역에서 통곡하는 소리가 나며, \q 언덕들에서 크게 무너지는 소리가 날 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 그때에 사람들이 물고기 문에서 부르짖을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 도성의 새 구역인 둘째 구역에서 사람들이 통곡할 것이다. \q 언덕들에서 크게 무너지는 소리가 날 것이다.

decisions.choice: the Fish Gate and the Second Quarter: parts of Jerusalem on its northern side
decisions.reason: The Fish Gate was in the northern wall of Jerusalem (2 Chronicles 33:14; Nehemiah 3:3), perhaps named for the fish brought there to market. The Second Quarter was a newer district of the city, where the prophetess Huldah lived (2 Kings 22:14). An enemy attacking Jerusalem usually came from the north, where the ground is level, so the cries begin there. The hills are those on which the city stood. |

decisions.choice: a great crash: the noise of something breaking and falling
decisions.reason: The word means a breaking or shattering. It is the sound of walls and houses falling as the city is taken, heard from the hills of Jerusalem. |

decisions.choice: the Second Quarter, the newer part of the city (R)
decisions.reason: Readable adds what the Second Quarter was (m1) and makes each cry its own sentence. |

decisions.choice: "la puerta del Pescado"; "el Segundo Barrio"
decisions.reason: The names published in Nehemiah 3:3 and 2 Kings 22:14.

decisions.choice: "la porte des Poissons"; "le second quartier"
decisions.reason: The names published in Nehemiah 3:3 and 2 Kings 22:14.

decisions.choice: "Lango la Samaki"; "Mtaa wa Pili"
decisions.reason: The names published in Nehemiah 3:3 and 2 Kings 22:14.

decisions.choice: "Cổng Cá"; "Khu Thứ Hai"
decisions.reason: The names published in Nehemiah 3:3 and 2 Kings 22:14.

decisions.choice: "물고기 문"; "둘째 구역"; the formula "주의 선언이다" (L) / "주가 말한다" (B) at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: The names published in Nehemiah 3:3 and 2 Kings 22:14. The formula stands as its own sentence in Korean, so Literal and Balanced place it after the verse's list of sounds rather than inside it; Readable places it after the first sentence.

source.text: הֵילִ֖ילוּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הַמַּכְתֵּ֑שׁ כִּ֤י נִדְמָה֙ כָּל־עַ֣ם כְּנַ֔עַן נִכְרְת֖וּ כָּל־נְטִ֥ילֵי כָֽסֶף׃

records.literal_gloss: Wail, inhabitants of the Mortar, for all [the] people of Canaan are destroyed; cut off [are] all who weigh out silver.

en.L: Wail, inhabitants of the Mortar, \q for all the people of Canaan are destroyed; \q cut off are all who weigh out silver.
en.B: Wail, you who live in the Mortar, \q for all the merchants are destroyed; \q all who trade with silver are cut off.
en.R: Cry out in grief, you who live in the part of the city called the Mortar! \q All the traders will be destroyed. \q Everyone who buys and sells for silver will be wiped out.

es.L: {{plural_you:Giman|Gemid}}, habitantes del Mortero, \q porque está destruido todo el pueblo de Canaán; \q exterminados [están] todos los que pesan plata.
es.B: {{plural_you:Giman, ustedes que viven|Gemid, vosotros que vivís}} en el Mortero, \q porque todos los comerciantes han sido destruidos; \q todos los que negocian con plata han sido eliminados.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Lloren|Llorad}} de dolor, {{plural_you:ustedes que viven|vosotros que vivís}} en la parte de la ciudad llamada el Mortero! \q Todos los comerciantes serán destruidos. \q Todos los que compran y venden por plata serán eliminados.

fr.L: Lamentez-vous, habitants du Mortier, \q car tout le peuple de Canaan est détruit ; \q retranchés [sont] tous ceux qui pèsent l’argent.
fr.B: Lamentez-vous, vous qui habitez le Mortier, \q car tous les marchands sont détruits ; \q tous ceux qui trafiquent l’argent sont retranchés.
fr.R: Criez de douleur, vous qui habitez le quartier appelé le Mortier ! \q Tous les commerçants seront détruits. \q Tous ceux qui achètent et vendent contre de l’argent seront supprimés.

sw.L: Ombolezeni, wakaaji wa Kinu, \q kwa maana watu wote wa Kanaani wameangamizwa; \q wamekatiliwa mbali wote wapimao fedha.
sw.B: Ombolezeni, ninyi mnaoishi katika mtaa wa Kinu, \q kwa maana wafanyabiashara wote wameangamizwa; \q wote wafanyao biashara kwa fedha wamekatiliwa mbali.
sw.R: Lieni kwa huzuni, ninyi mnaoishi katika sehemu ya mji inayoitwa Kinu! \q Wafanyabiashara wote wataangamizwa. \q Kila anayenunua na kuuza kwa fedha atafutiliwa mbali.

vi.L: Hãy than khóc, hỡi cư dân Cối Giã, \q vì cả dân Ca-na-an đã bị diệt; \q mọi kẻ cân bạc đều bị diệt trừ.
vi.B: Hãy gào khóc, hỡi những người sống ở khu Cối Giã, \q vì mọi kẻ buôn bán đều bị tiêu diệt; \q mọi kẻ giao dịch bằng bạc đều bị diệt trừ.
vi.R: Hãy kêu khóc đau thương, hỡi những người sống trong khu phố gọi là Cối Giã! \q Mọi con buôn sẽ bị tiêu diệt. \q Mọi kẻ mua bán bằng bạc sẽ bị xóa sạch.

ko.L: 절구 [구역]의 주민들아, 울부짖어라. \q 가나안 백성이 다 망하였고, \q 은을 다는 자들이 다 끊어졌다.
ko.B: 절구 구역에 사는 자들아, 통곡하여라. \q 상인들이 모두 망하였고, \q 은으로 장사하는 자들이 모두 끊어졌다.
ko.R: '절구'라고 부르는 동네에 사는 사람들아, 슬피 울어라! \q 장사꾼들이 모두 망할 것이다. \q 은을 받고 사고파는 사람들이 모두 없어질 것이다.

decisions.choice: the Mortar: a district of Jerusalem, probably a hollow where the market was
decisions.reason: The word means a mortar, a bowl for pounding grain, and is used of a hollow in the ground (Judges 15:19). Here it is a part of Jerusalem, probably in the valley that runs through the city, where traders did business. The name also suggests that its people will be pounded as in a mortar.

decisions.choice: the people of Canaan: the traders
decisions.reason: The Canaanites, and especially the Phoenicians of the coast, were known as traders, so "Canaanite" came to mean "merchant" (Hosea 12:8; Proverbs 31:24; Isaiah 23:8). The parallel line, "all who weigh out silver", shows that this is the sense here. |

decisions.choice: who weigh out silver: those who handle money in trade
decisions.reason: There were no coins yet in Judah. Payment was made by weighing out silver on scales (Genesis 23:16; Jeremiah 32:9). |

decisions.choice: Wail (L, B), Cry out in grief (R); the people of Canaan (L), the merchants (B), the traders (R)
decisions.reason: "Wail" follows the Isaiah table for this cry. Literal keeps "the people of Canaan" and Balanced and Readable give its sense (m2). |

decisions.choice: "Giman" (L, B), "Lloren de dolor" (R), with plural_you; "el Mortero"
decisions.reason: The cry follows the Spanish of Isaiah 13:6, plural because the inhabitants are addressed. The district's name is translated, as the English does and as Spanish already translates the Fish Gate and the Second Quarter, so that its meaning (m1) can be seen.

decisions.choice: "Lamentez-vous" (L, B), "Criez de douleur" (R); "le Mortier"
decisions.reason: The cry follows the French of Isaiah 13:6. The district's name is translated, as the English does, so that its meaning (m1) can be seen.

decisions.choice: "Ombolezeni" (L, B), "Lieni kwa huzuni" (R); "Kinu"
decisions.reason: The cry follows the Swahili of Isaiah 13:6. The district's name is translated as "Kinu", the Swahili word for a mortar, as the English translates it, so that its meaning (m1) can be seen.

decisions.choice: "Hãy than khóc" (L), "Hãy gào khóc" (B), "Hãy kêu khóc đau thương" (R); "Cối Giã"
decisions.reason: The cry follows the Vietnamese of Isaiah 13:6. The district's name is translated, as "Cổng Cá" and "Khu Thứ Hai" are, so that its meaning (m1) can be seen; the 1926 transliteration was "Mặc-tết".

decisions.choice: "울부짖어라" (L), "통곡하여라" (B), "슬피 울어라" (R); "절구 구역"
decisions.reason: The cry follows the Korean of Isaiah 13:6. The district's name is translated, as 물고기 문 and 둘째 구역 are, so that its meaning (m1) can be seen; the older Korean Bibles transliterate it as 막데스.

source.text: וְהָיָה֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא אֲחַפֵּ֥שׂ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּנֵּר֑וֹת וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י עַל־הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַקֹּֽפְאִים֙ עַל־שִׁמְרֵיהֶ֔ם הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔ם לֹֽא־יֵיטִ֥יב יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יָרֵֽעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be at that time, I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are thickening on their dregs, who say in their heart, Yahweh will not do good and will not do harm.

en.L: And it will be at that time \q that I will search through Jerusalem with lamps, \q and I will punish the {{gender:people|men}} who are thickening on their dregs, \q who say in their heart, \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will not do good, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not do harm."
en.B: At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps \q and punish those who are complacent, \q like wine left to thicken on its dregs, \q who say to themselves, \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will do nothing, neither good nor bad."
en.R: At that time I will search every corner of Jerusalem with lamps. \q I will punish the people who are lazy and satisfied with themselves, like wine left too long on its dregs. \q They think, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will not do anything, good or bad."

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel tiempo \q que registraré Jerusalén con lámparas, \q y castigaré {{gender:a las personas|a los hombres}} que se espesan sobre sus heces, \q que dicen en su corazón: \q «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no hará bien, ni hará mal».
es.B: En aquel tiempo registraré Jerusalén con lámparas \q y castigaré a los que viven confiados, \q como vino que se deja espesar sobre sus heces, \q que dicen para sí: \q «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no hará nada, ni bueno ni malo».
es.R: En ese tiempo registraré con lámparas cada rincón de Jerusalén. \q Castigaré a la gente perezosa y satisfecha de sí misma, como vino que se ha dejado demasiado tiempo sobre sus heces. \q Ellos piensan: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no hará nada, ni bueno ni malo».

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce temps-là \q que je fouillerai Jérusalem avec des lampes, \q et je punirai {{gender:les gens|les hommes}} qui s’épaississent sur leur lie, \q qui disent dans leur cœur : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne fera pas de bien, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne fera pas de mal. »
fr.B: En ce temps-là, je fouillerai Jérusalem avec des lampes \q et je punirai ceux qui vivent dans l’insouciance, \q comme un vin laissé à épaissir sur sa lie, \q qui se disent : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne fera rien, ni bien ni mal. »
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je fouillerai avec des lampes chaque recoin de Jérusalem. \q Je punirai les gens paresseux et contents d’eux-mêmes, comme un vin qu’on a laissé trop longtemps sur sa lie. \q Ils pensent : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne fera rien, ni bien ni mal. »

sw.L: Na itakuwa wakati ule \q kwamba nitaipekua Yerusalemu kwa taa, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawaadhibu watu wanaoganda juu ya machujo yao, \q wasemao mioyoni mwao, \q "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatatenda mema, wala hatatenda mabaya."
sw.B: Wakati huo nitaipekua Yerusalemu kwa taa \q na kuwaadhibu wale wanaostarehe bila kujali, \q kama divai iliyoachwa iganda juu ya machujo yake, \q wanaojiambia, \q "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatafanya lolote, jema wala baya."
sw.R: Wakati huo nitapekua kila pembe ya Yerusalemu kwa taa. \q Nitawaadhibu watu walio wavivu na wanaojiridhisha, kama divai iliyoachwa muda mrefu mno juu ya machujo yake. \q Wanafikiri, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatafanya kitu chochote, kizuri wala kibaya."

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra vào lúc ấy, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cầm đèn lục soát Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt những kẻ đặc lại trên cặn rượu của mình, \q những kẻ nói trong lòng: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không làm điều lành, cũng không làm điều dữ."
vi.B: Vào lúc ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cầm đèn lục soát Giê-ru-sa-lem \q và trừng phạt những kẻ tự mãn, \q như rượu để lâu đặc lại trên cặn, \q những kẻ tự nhủ: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chẳng làm gì cả, dù lành hay dữ."
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cầm đèn lục soát từng ngóc ngách của Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Ta sẽ trừng phạt những kẻ lười biếng và tự mãn, như rượu để quá lâu trên cặn. \q Chúng nghĩ: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chẳng làm gì cả, dù tốt hay xấu."

ko.L: 그때가 되면 \q 내가 등불을 켜 들고 예루살렘을 뒤지고, \q 찌끼 위에서 엉겨 붙은 자들을 벌하겠다. \q 그들은 마음속으로 \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 복도 내리지 않으시고 화도 내리지 않으신다" 하고 말하는 자들이다.
ko.B: 그때에 내가 등불을 켜 들고 예루살렘을 뒤져, \q 안일하게 사는 자들, \q 찌끼 위에서 엉겨 버린 포도주 같은 자들을 벌하겠다. \q 그들은 속으로 \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 좋은 일도 나쁜 일도 하지 않으신다" 하고 말한다.
ko.R: 그때에 내가 등불을 켜 들고 예루살렘 구석구석을 뒤지겠다. \q 너무 오래 찌끼 위에 둔 포도주처럼 게으르고 자기만족에 빠진 사람들을 벌하겠다. \q 그들은 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 좋은 일이든 나쁜 일이든 아무것도 하지 않으실 것이다" 하고 생각한다.

decisions.choice: search Jerusalem with lamps: search every dark corner, so that no one escapes
decisions.reason: A lamp was needed to search a house thoroughly (Luke 15:8). The picture is of a search from which no one can hide (Amos 9:2-3). |

decisions.choice: thickening on their dregs: settled, complacent, unmoved
decisions.reason: Wine was left on its dregs for a time to gain strength and flavor, but if it was left too long it thickened and turned syrupy. Jeremiah 48:11 says that Moab has "settled on its dregs" because it was never poured from vessel to vessel. The people are comfortable and stagnant, untouched by any change. |

decisions.choice: will not do good and will not do harm: will do nothing at all
decisions.reason: Naming two opposites means "anything at all" (Jeremiah 10:5; Isaiah 41:23). They do not deny that the LORD exists; they think he will not act, so they need not take him into account. The day of the LORD answers them. |

decisions.choice: the people (L, gender default), those who (B)
decisions.reason: The word means men, but here it stands for the complacent people of Jerusalem, women and men alike, so Literal uses the gender setting and Balanced says "those who". |

decisions.choice: complacent, like wine left to thicken on its dregs (B); lazy and satisfied with themselves (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the picture means (m2) and keep the picture itself. The people's words are set in double quotes as speech quoted inside the oracle. |

decisions.choice: "{{gender:a las personas|a los hombres}}" (L)
decisions.reason: Spanish has two wordings for the Hebrew word for men, so Literal carries the English gender setting on the noun; Balanced says "los que", as the English "those who". The people's words are in « », as speech quoted inside the oracle.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:les gens|les hommes}}" (L)
decisions.reason: French has two wordings for the Hebrew word for men, so Literal carries the English gender setting on the noun; Balanced says "ceux qui". The people's words are in « », as speech quoted inside the oracle.

decisions.choice: "watu" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Watu" already includes women and men, so the English gender setting has nothing to change in Swahili. The people's words are in double quotes, as speech quoted inside the oracle.

decisions.choice: "những kẻ" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "những kẻ" already includes women and men, so the English gender setting has nothing to change. The people's words are in double quotes, as speech quoted inside the oracle.

decisions.choice: "주께서는 … 않으신다": the people speak of the LORD with -시-
decisions.reason: Human speech about God gives him the honorific, even from people who think he will do nothing; the scorn is in what they say, not in the grammar. "자들" and "사람들" already include women and men, so no gender span is needed.

source.text: וְהָיָ֤ה חֵילָם֙ לִמְשִׁסָּ֔ה וּבָתֵּיהֶ֖ם לִשְׁמָמָ֑ה וּבָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְלֹ֣א יֵשֵׁ֔בוּ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁתּ֖וּ אֶת־יֵינָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And their wealth will become plunder, and their houses a desolation; and they will build houses and not dwell [in them], and they will plant vineyards and not drink their wine.

en.L: And their wealth will become plunder, \q and their houses a desolation; \q they will build houses but not dwell [in them], \q and they will plant vineyards but not drink their wine.
en.B: Their wealth will be plundered \q and their houses left in ruins. \q They will build houses but not live in them; \q they will plant vineyards but not drink their wine.
en.R: Their riches will be stolen, \q and their houses will be destroyed. \q They will build houses, but they will never live in them. \q They will plant vineyards, but they will never drink the wine.

es.L: Y su riqueza vendrá a ser botín, \q y sus casas, desolación; \q edificarán casas, pero no [las] habitarán, \q y plantarán viñas, pero no beberán su vino.
es.B: Su riqueza será saqueada \q y sus casas quedarán en ruinas. \q Construirán casas, pero no vivirán en ellas; \q plantarán viñas, pero no beberán su vino.
es.R: Les robarán sus riquezas, \q y sus casas serán destruidas. \q Construirán casas, pero nunca vivirán en ellas. \q Plantarán viñas, pero nunca beberán el vino.

fr.L: Et leur richesse deviendra un butin, \q et leurs maisons une désolation ; \q ils bâtiront des maisons mais n’[y] habiteront pas, \q et ils planteront des vignes mais n’en boiront pas le vin.
fr.B: Leurs richesses seront pillées \q et leurs maisons laissées en ruine. \q Ils bâtiront des maisons sans y habiter ; \q ils planteront des vignes sans en boire le vin.
fr.R: On leur volera leurs richesses, \q et leurs maisons seront détruites. \q Ils construiront des maisons, mais ils n’y vivront jamais. \q Ils planteront des vignes, mais ils n’en boiront jamais le vin.

sw.L: Na mali yao itakuwa nyara, \q na nyumba zao ukiwa; \q watajenga nyumba lakini hawatakaa [ndani yake], \q na watapanda mizabibu lakini hawatakunywa divai yake.
sw.B: Mali yao itatekwa nyara \q na nyumba zao zitaachwa magofu. \q Watajenga nyumba lakini hawataishi ndani yake; \q watapanda mizabibu lakini hawatakunywa divai yake.
sw.R: Utajiri wao utaibiwa, \q na nyumba zao zitaharibiwa. \q Watajenga nyumba, lakini hawataishi ndani yake kamwe. \q Watapanda mizabibu, lakini hawatakunywa divai yake kamwe.

vi.L: Của cải chúng sẽ thành của cướp, \q và nhà cửa chúng thành hoang vu; \q chúng sẽ xây nhà nhưng không được ở [trong đó], \q chúng sẽ trồng vườn nho nhưng không được uống rượu nho của mình.
vi.B: Của cải chúng sẽ bị cướp đoạt \q và nhà cửa chúng sẽ đổ nát. \q Chúng sẽ xây nhà nhưng không được ở; \q chúng sẽ trồng vườn nho nhưng không được uống rượu.
vi.R: Của cải của chúng sẽ bị cướp mất, \q và nhà cửa chúng sẽ bị phá hủy. \q Chúng sẽ xây nhà, nhưng chẳng bao giờ được ở. \q Chúng sẽ trồng vườn nho, nhưng chẳng bao giờ được uống rượu nho.

ko.L: 그들의 재물은 약탈물이 되고, \q 그들의 집들은 황무지가 될 것이다. \q 그들이 집을 지어도 [그 안에] 살지 못하고, \q 포도원을 가꾸어도 그 포도주를 마시지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들의 재산은 약탈당하고, \q 그들의 집은 폐허가 될 것이다. \q 그들은 집을 지어도 거기에서 살지 못하고, \q 포도원을 가꾸어도 거기서 난 포도주를 마시지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들의 재산은 빼앗기고, \q 집들은 무너질 것이다. \q 그들이 집을 지어도 그 집에서 결코 살지 못할 것이다. \q 포도밭을 가꾸어도 그 포도주를 결코 마시지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: build houses and not dwell in them, plant vineyards and not drink their wine: the curse of the covenant
decisions.reason: These are among the curses of Deuteronomy 28:30, 39 on a people who break the covenant, and Amos 5:11 uses them against Israel. The complacent who said that the LORD would do nothing (verse 12) find that he does what he warned he would do. Isaiah 65:21-22 turns the curse into a promise. |

decisions.choice: [in them] (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "and not dwell"; Literal brackets the words English needs. |

source.text: קָר֤וֹב יוֹם־יְהוָה֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל קָר֖וֹב וּמַהֵ֣ר מְאֹ֑ד ק֚וֹל י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה מַ֥ר צֹרֵ֖חַ שָׁ֥ם גִּבּֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Near [is] the great day of Yahweh, near and hastening greatly; [the] sound of [the] day of Yahweh; bitterly a warrior cries out there.

en.L: Near [is] the great day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q near and hastening fast; \q the sound of the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Bitterly the warrior cries out there.
en.B: The great day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is close at hand, \q close and coming very fast. \q Listen! The day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q There the warrior cries out in bitter anguish.
en.R: The great day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is near. \q It is coming closer, and coming fast. \q Listen! It is the sound of the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Even strong soldiers will cry out bitterly then.

es.L: Cerca [está] el gran día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q cerca, y se apresura mucho; \q ¡el sonido del día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}! \q Amargamente grita allí el guerrero.
es.B: El gran día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está cerca, \q cerca y viene a toda prisa. \q ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}! ¡El día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}! \q Allí el guerrero clama con amarga angustia.
es.R: El gran día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está cerca. \q Se acerca más y más, y viene rápido. \q ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}! Es el sonido del día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q Entonces hasta los soldados más fuertes llorarán amargamente.

fr.L: Il est proche, le grand jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q proche, et il se hâte beaucoup ; \q le bruit du jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! \q Amèrement, là, le guerrier crie.
fr.B: Le grand jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est tout proche, \q tout proche, et il arrive très vite. \q Écoutez ! Le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! \q Là, même le guerrier hurle d’angoisse.
fr.R: Le grand jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est proche. \q Il approche, et il approche vite. \q Écoutez ! C’est le bruit du jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q Ce jour-là, même les soldats les plus forts pleureront amèrement.

sw.L: Siku kuu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [i] karibu, \q [i] karibu, tena yaja kwa kasi mno; \q sauti ya siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Kwa uchungu shujaa anapaza kilio pale.
sw.B: Siku kuu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} imekaribia, \q imekaribia na inakuja upesi sana. \q Sikilizeni! Siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Pale shujaa analia kwa uchungu mkuu.
sw.R: Siku kuu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} iko karibu. \q Inazidi kukaribia, na inakuja haraka. \q Sikilizeni! Ni sauti ya siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Siku hiyo hata askari hodari watalia kwa uchungu.

vi.L: Ngày lớn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã gần, \q gần lắm và đang vội vã đến; \q tiếng ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Tại đó dũng sĩ kêu la cay đắng.
vi.B: Ngày lớn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã gần kề, \q gần kề và đang đến thật nhanh. \q Hãy nghe! Ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Tại đó người chiến binh gào thét trong đau đớn tột cùng.
vi.R: Ngày lớn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã gần. \q Ngày ấy đang đến gần hơn, và đến rất nhanh. \q Hãy lắng nghe tiếng ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang đến! \q Khi ấy ngay cả những người lính mạnh mẽ cũng sẽ khóc than cay đắng.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 큰 날이 가깝다. \q 가깝고 매우 빨리 다가온다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날의 소리여! \q 거기서 용사가 쓰라리게 울부짖는다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 큰 날이 가까이 왔다. \q 가까이 왔고, 아주 빠르게 닥쳐온다. \q 들어라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이다! \q 거기서 용사가 괴로움에 못 이겨 소리친다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 큰 날이 가까이 왔다. \q 점점 더 가까이, 빠르게 오고 있다. \q 들어 보아라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 오는 소리다. \q 그때에는 힘센 군인들도 쓰라리게 울 것이다.

decisions.choice: the great day of the LORD: the day when the LORD comes to judge
decisions.reason: Verses 14-18 are the fullest description in the prophets of the day of the LORD, the day when the LORD comes to act against all that is proud and wicked. See the note at Joel 1:15. Zephaniah takes up the words of Isaiah 13:6 ("near is the day of the LORD") and Joel 2:2 ("a day of darkness and gloom", verse 15). |

decisions.choice: the sound of the day of the LORD! Bitterly the warrior cries out
alternatives: the sound of the day of the LORD is bitter; the warrior cries out there
decisions.reason: The Hebrew accents divide the line after "the day of the LORD", so that "bitter" goes with the warrior's cry. Without the accents the words could be read "the sound of the day of the LORD is bitter". The sense is close either way.

decisions.choice: the warrior cries out there: even the strongest soldier cries out in distress
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for a mighty warrior. On that day even he will cry out in distress, not in triumph (Amos 2:14-16; Jeremiah 46:5-6). "There" points to the scene of the day. |

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 13:6 and Joel 1:15 at each level
decisions.reason: "Near [is] the day of the LORD" (L), "is close at hand" (B) and "is near" (R) are the wording published in Isaiah 13:6 and Joel 1:15, as set for the day of the LORD in the Twelve. Balanced and Readable say "Listen!" for "the sound of", as an exclamation. Readable says "then" for "there", because the line speaks of what will happen on the day. |

decisions.choice: "Cerca [está]" (L), "está cerca" (B, R), as Isaiah 13:6; "¡Escuchen!" with plural_you (B, R)
decisions.reason: The opening words are those of Isaiah 13:6 in Spanish at each level. The line was drafted from the Hebrew and kept away from the familiar Reina-Valera wording. Balanced and Readable say "Listen!" for "the sound of", as the English does, addressed to all.

decisions.choice: "Il est proche, le grand jour" (L), "est tout proche" (B), "est proche" (R), as Isaiah 13:6
decisions.reason: The opening words are those of Isaiah 13:6 in French at each level; the rest was drafted from the Hebrew and kept away from the familiar French wordings. "Écoutez !" for "the sound of" at Balanced and Readable, as the English.

decisions.choice: "[i] karibu" (L), "imekaribia" (B), "iko karibu" (R), as Isaiah 13:6; "shujaa" for the warrior
decisions.reason: The opening words are those of Isaiah 13:6 in Swahili at each level; the rest was drafted from the Hebrew and kept away from the Union Version's wording of this verse.

decisions.choice: "đã gần" (L, R), "đã gần kề" (B), as Isaiah 13:6; "ngày của CHÚA" at every level
decisions.reason: The day of the LORD keeps one wording, as published Isaiah 13:6 and Joel. The rest was drafted from the Hebrew and kept away from the 1926 wording. Readable joins "Listen" and "the sound" in one call to hear.

decisions.choice: "가깝다" (L), "가까이 왔다" (B, R), as Isaiah 13:6; "용사" for the warrior
decisions.reason: The opening words are those of Isaiah 13:6 in Korean at each level. The verse was drafted from the Hebrew and kept away from the familiar 개역 and 새번역 lines.

source.text: י֥וֹם עֶבְרָ֖ה הַיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא י֧וֹם צָרָ֣ה וּמְצוּקָ֗ה י֤וֹם שֹׁאָה֙ וּמְשׁוֹאָ֔ה י֥וֹם חֹ֨שֶׁךְ֙ וַאֲפֵלָ֔ה י֥וֹם עָנָ֖ן וַעֲרָפֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: A day of fury [is] that day, a day of distress and anguish, a day of ruin and devastation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of cloud and thick darkness,

en.L: A day of fury [is] that day, \q a day of distress and anguish, a day of ruin and devastation, \q a day of darkness and gloom, \q a day of clouds and thick darkness,
en.B: That day will be a day of fury, \q a day of distress and anguish, a day of ruin and devastation, \q a day of darkness and gloom, \q a day of clouds and deep darkness,
en.R: That day will be a day of terrible anger, \q a day of trouble and pain, a day of ruin and destruction, \q a dark and gloomy day, a day of black clouds,

es.L: Día de furor [es] aquel día, \q día de angustia y aflicción, día de ruina y devastación, \q día de tinieblas y de oscuridad, \q día de nubes y de densas tinieblas,
es.B: Aquel día será un día de furor, \q un día de angustia y aflicción, un día de ruina y devastación, \q un día de tinieblas y oscuridad, \q un día de nubes y negrura,
es.R: Aquel día será un día de una ira terrible, \q un día de problemas y dolor, un día de ruina y destrucción, \q un día oscuro y sombrío, un día de nubes negras,

fr.L: Un jour de fureur, [voilà] ce jour-là, \q un jour de détresse et de tourment, un jour de désastre et de dévastation, \q un jour de ténèbres et d’obscurité, \q un jour de nuées et de brume épaisse,
fr.B: Ce jour-là sera un jour de fureur, \q un jour de détresse et de tourment, un jour de désastre et de dévastation, \q un jour de ténèbres et d’obscurité, \q un jour de nuages et de nuit épaisse,
fr.R: Ce jour-là sera un jour de terrible colère, \q un jour de malheur et de souffrance, un jour de ruine et de destruction, \q un jour sombre et triste, un jour de nuages noirs,

vi.L: Ngày phẫn nộ [là] ngày ấy, \q một ngày khốn khó và khổ não, một ngày đổ nát và điêu tàn, \q một ngày tối tăm và u ám, \q một ngày mây và mù mịt.
vi.B: Ngày ấy sẽ là ngày thịnh nộ, \q ngày khốn khó và khổ não, ngày đổ nát và điêu tàn, \q ngày tối tăm và u ám, \q ngày mây đen và tối mịt.
vi.R: Ngày ấy sẽ là ngày của cơn giận dữ dội, \q ngày gian nan và đau đớn, ngày tàn phá và hủy diệt, \q ngày tối tăm và ảm đạm, ngày đầy mây đen.

ko.L: 그날은 진노의 날, \q 괴로움과 고통의 날, 파멸과 폐허의 날, \q 어둠과 캄캄함의 날, \q 구름과 짙은 어둠의 날이다.
ko.B: 그날은 진노의 날이 될 것이다. \q 괴로움과 고통의 날, 파멸과 폐허의 날, \q 어둡고 캄캄한 날, \q 구름이 끼고 짙은 어둠이 덮인 날이다.
ko.R: 그날은 무서운 분노의 날이 될 것이다. \q 고생하고 아파하는 날, 무너지고 망하는 날, \q 어둡고 캄캄한 날, 시커먼 구름이 덮인 날이다.

decisions.choice: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness: the words of Joel 2:2
decisions.reason: The same four words describe the day of the LORD in Joel 2:2. Clouds and thick darkness also surrounded the LORD when he came down on Mount Sinai (Deuteronomy 4:11; Exodus 20:21): the day is the coming of God himself. Amos had said that the day would be darkness, not light (Amos 5:18-20). |

decisions.choice: distress and anguish, ruin and devastation: pairs of words that sound alike
decisions.reason: Each pair joins two words of the same sound and sense, for emphasis. The second pair is especially close in sound (sho'ah umesho'ah). The six pairs hammer home the one day. |

decisions.choice: a day of fury is that day: the words behind the hymn "Dies irae"
decisions.reason: In the Latin translation this line begins "dies irae, dies illa" ("a day of wrath, that day"). The medieval Latin hymn on the last judgment that begins with these words, the "Dies irae", was long sung in the Western church's mass for the dead. |

decisions.choice: the wording of Joel 2:2 at each level
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats Joel 2:2, each level uses the wording published there: "a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness" (L), "a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and deep darkness" (B), "a dark and gloomy day, a day of black clouds" (R). "Fury" follows Isaiah 13:9 at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "terrible anger", as there. |

decisions.choice: the wording of Joel 2:2 at each level for the last two pairs; "furor" (L, B), "una ira terrible" (R)
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats Joel 2:2, each level uses the Spanish published there. "Fury" follows Isaiah 13:9. The first pairs were drafted from the Hebrew, each pair of like-sounding words kept as two nouns (m2), and checked against the Reina-Valera wording of this famous verse.

decisions.choice: the wording of Joel 2:2 at each level for the last two pairs; "fureur" (L, B), "terrible colère" (R)
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats Joel 2:2, each level uses the French published there; "fureur" follows Isaiah 13:9. The first pairs were drafted from the Hebrew ("détresse et tourment", "désastre et dévastation") and kept away from the familiar French wording of the "Dies irae" verse.

decisions.choice: the wording of Joel 2:2 for the last two pairs; "ghadhabu" (L, B), "hasira kali" (R)
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats Joel 2:2, each level uses the Swahili published there; "ghadhabu" follows Isaiah 13:9. The second pair is "maangamizi na maafa", two words of ruin, drafted from the Hebrew and kept apart from the Union Version's wording.

decisions.choice: the wording of Joel 2:2 for the last two pairs; each verse of 1:14-18 closes as its own sentence
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats Joel 2:2, each level uses the Vietnamese published there; "phẫn nộ" (L) and "thịnh nộ" (B) follow Isaiah 13:9. The Hebrew sentence runs on into verse 16; Vietnamese closes each verse as its own sentence and verse 16 opens with "Đó là ngày", as the Psalms rule sets.

decisions.choice: the wording of Joel 2:2 for the last two pairs; "진노" (L, B), "무서운 분노" (R); each verse its own sentence
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah repeats Joel 2:2, each level uses the Korean published there; "진노" follows Isaiah 13:9. Korean closes each verse as its own sentence, so verse 15 ends in "날이다" and verse 16 has its own "…날이다". The pairs were drafted from the Hebrew and kept away from the 개역 and 새번역 lines.

source.text: י֥וֹם שׁוֹפָ֖ר וּתְרוּעָ֑ה עַ֚ל הֶעָרִ֣ים הַבְּצֻר֔וֹת וְעַ֖ל הַפִּנּ֥וֹת הַגְּבֹהֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: a day of trumpet and battle cry against the fortified cities and against the high corners.

en.L: a day of trumpet and battle cry \q against the fortified cities \q and against the high corners.
en.B: a day of the ram's horn and the battle cry \q against the fortified cities \q and against the lofty corner towers.
en.R: a day when trumpets sound and soldiers shout for battle \q against the strong cities with walls \q and against the high towers at their corners.

es.L: día de trompeta y grito de guerra \q contra las ciudades fortificadas \q y contra las altas esquinas.
es.B: día del cuerno de carnero y del grito de batalla \q contra las ciudades fortificadas \q y contra las altas torres de las esquinas.
es.R: un día en que sonarán las trompetas y los soldados gritarán para la batalla \q contra las ciudades fuertes y amuralladas \q y contra las torres altas de sus esquinas.

fr.L: un jour de cor et de cri de guerre \q contre les villes fortifiées \q et contre les angles élevés.
fr.B: un jour où retentissent le cor et le cri de guerre \q contre les villes fortifiées \q et contre les hautes tours d’angle.
fr.R: un jour où les trompettes sonneront et où les soldats pousseront le cri de bataille \q contre les villes fortes entourées de murs \q et contre les hautes tours à leurs angles.

sw.L: siku ya baragumu na kelele ya vita \q juu ya miji yenye ngome \q na juu ya pembe za juu.
sw.B: siku ya baragumu na ukelele wa vita \q dhidi ya miji yenye ngome \q na dhidi ya minara mirefu ya pembeni.
sw.R: siku ambayo baragumu zitapigwa na askari watapiga kelele za vita \q dhidi ya miji yenye nguvu na kuta \q na dhidi ya minara mirefu iliyo kwenye pembe zake.

vi.L: [Đó là] ngày tiếng kèn và tiếng hò xung trận \q nghịch cùng các thành kiên cố \q và nghịch cùng các góc thành cao.
vi.B: Đó là ngày tiếng tù và và tiếng hò xung trận vang lên \q nghịch cùng các thành kiên cố \q và nghịch cùng các tháp cao nơi góc tường.
vi.R: Đó là ngày tiếng kèn vang dội và quân lính hò hét xung trận \q tấn công các thành vững chắc có tường bao quanh \q và các tháp cao ở các góc thành.

ko.L: 나팔과 전쟁 함성의 날, \q 견고한 성읍들을 치고 \q 높은 모퉁이들을 치는 날이다.
ko.B: 숫양 뿔 나팔 소리와 전쟁의 함성이 \q 견고한 성읍들과 \q 높은 모퉁이 망대들을 향해 울리는 날이다.
ko.R: 나팔이 울리고 군인들이 싸움의 함성을 지르며 \q 성벽으로 둘러싸인 튼튼한 성읍들과 \q 성 모퉁이의 높은 망대들을 공격하는 날이다.

decisions.choice: trumpet and battle cry: the signals of an attack
decisions.reason: The ram's horn was blown to sound the alarm or the attack, and the army raised a shout as it charged (Amos 2:2; Jeremiah 4:19). |

decisions.choice: the high corner towers: the towers or battlements at the corners of city walls
decisions.reason: The word means "corners", and on walls it means the corner towers, the strongest points of the defenses (2 Chronicles 26:15). Even they will not stand. |

decisions.choice: trumpet (L, R), ram's horn (B); high corners (L), corner towers (B), towers at their corners (R)
decisions.reason: The ram's horn (shofar) follows the Isaiah table. Literal keeps the word "corners"; Balanced and Readable say what the corners of a wall are (m2). |

decisions.choice: "trompeta" (L, R), "cuerno de carnero" (B)
decisions.reason: The shofar as the Spanish prophets have it (Isaiah, Joel 2:1), following the English choice at each level.

decisions.choice: "cor" (L, B), "trompette" (R)
decisions.reason: The shofar as the French prophets settle it (Joel 2:1).

decisions.choice: "baragumu" at every level
decisions.reason: The shofar as the Swahili prophets settle it (Joel 2:1).

decisions.choice: "kèn" (L, R), "tù và" (B)
decisions.reason: The shofar as the Vietnamese prophets settle it (Joel 2:1).

decisions.choice: "나팔" (L, R), "숫양 뿔 나팔" (B)
decisions.reason: The shofar as the Korean prophets settle it (Joel 2:1).

source.text: וַהֲצֵרֹ֣תִי לָאָדָ֗ם וְהָֽלְכוּ֙ כַּֽעִוְרִ֔ים כִּ֥י לַֽיהוָ֖ה חָטָ֑אוּ וְשֻׁפַּ֤ךְ דָּמָם֙ כֶּֽעָפָ֔ר וּלְחֻמָ֖ם כַּגְּלָלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will bring distress on humankind, and they will walk like the blind, for against Yahweh they have sinned; and their blood will be poured out like dust, and their flesh like dung.

en.L: And I will bring distress on humankind, and they will walk like the blind, \q for against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} they have sinned; \q and their blood will be poured out as dust, \q and their flesh as dung.
en.B: I will bring such distress on people that they will grope like the blind, \q for they have sinned against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Their blood will be spilled out like dust \q and their flesh like dung.
en.R: I will bring trouble on people. They will stumble around like blind people, \q because they have sinned against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Their blood will be spilled like dust, \q and their dead bodies will lie on the ground like dung.

es.L: Y traeré angustia sobre los seres humanos, y andarán como los ciegos, \q porque contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} han pecado; \q y su sangre será derramada como polvo, \q y su carne como estiércol.
es.B: Traeré tanta angustia sobre la gente que andarán a tientas como ciegos, \q porque han pecado contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Su sangre será derramada como polvo \q y su carne como estiércol.
es.R: Traeré angustia sobre la gente. Andarán tropezando como ciegos, \q porque han pecado contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Su sangre será derramada como polvo, \q y sus cadáveres quedarán tirados en el suelo como estiércol.

fr.L: Et je mettrai les humains dans la détresse, et ils marcheront comme les aveugles, \q car contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ils ont péché ; \q et leur sang sera répandu comme de la poussière, \q et leur chair comme du fumier.
fr.B: J’accablerai les humains d’une telle détresse qu’ils marcheront à tâtons comme des aveugles, \q car ils ont péché contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Leur sang sera répandu comme de la poussière, \q et leur chair comme des excréments.
fr.R: J’enverrai le malheur sur les gens. Ils trébucheront comme des aveugles, \q parce qu’ils ont péché contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Leur sang sera répandu comme de la poussière, \q et leurs cadavres resteront par terre comme du fumier.

sw.L: Nami nitawaletea wanadamu dhiki, nao watatembea kama vipofu, \q kwa maana dhidi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wametenda dhambi; \q na damu yao itamwagwa kama mavumbi, \q na nyama yao kama mavi.
sw.B: Nitawaletea watu dhiki kiasi kwamba watapapasa kama vipofu, \q kwa maana wametenda dhambi dhidi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Damu yao itamwagika kama mavumbi \q na nyama yao kama mavi.
sw.R: Nitawaletea watu taabu. Watajikwaa huku na huko kama vipofu, \q kwa sababu wametenda dhambi dhidi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Damu yao itamwagika kama mavumbi, \q na maiti zao zitalala ardhini kama mavi.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giáng khốn quẫn trên loài người, và chúng sẽ bước đi như kẻ mù, \q vì chúng đã phạm tội nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q và máu chúng sẽ bị đổ ra như bụi đất, \q và thịt chúng như phân.
vi.B: Ta sẽ giáng khốn quẫn trên loài người đến nỗi chúng sẽ dò dẫm như người mù, \q vì chúng đã phạm tội nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Máu chúng sẽ bị đổ ra như bụi đất \q và thịt chúng như phân.
vi.R: Ta sẽ đem tai họa đến trên loài người. Chúng sẽ đi loạng choạng như người mù, \q vì chúng đã phạm tội nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Máu chúng sẽ bị đổ ra như bụi đất, \q và xác chúng sẽ nằm trên mặt đất như phân.

ko.L: 내가 사람들에게 고난을 내려, 그들이 눈먼 자들처럼 걸을 것이다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 죄를 지었기 때문이다. \q 그들의 피는 먼지처럼 쏟아지고, \q 그들의 살은 똥처럼 [버려질 것이다].
ko.B: 내가 사람들에게 고난을 내리겠다. 그들이 눈먼 사람처럼 더듬거리며 다닐 것이다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 죄를 지었기 때문이다. \q 그들의 피는 먼지처럼 쏟아지고, \q 그들의 살은 오물처럼 버려질 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 사람들에게 재앙을 내리겠다. 그들은 눈먼 사람처럼 비틀거리며 다닐 것이다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 죄를 지었기 때문이다. \q 그들의 피는 먼지처럼 흩뿌려지고, \q 그들의 시체는 오물처럼 땅바닥에 나뒹굴 것이다.

decisions.choice: they will walk like the blind: the covenant curse of Deuteronomy 28:28-29
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy warns that a disobedient people will grope at noon as a blind man gropes in the dark. Those who did not seek the LORD (verse 6) will not find their way. |

decisions.choice: their flesh: their bodies, perhaps their bowels
decisions.reason: The word is rare. It is used in Job 20:23 for the body, and a related Arabic word means flesh. Some take it as the inner parts of the body. Either way, the bodies of the dead are thrown out like dung.

decisions.choice: poured out like dust: poured out in great quantity and treated as worthless
decisions.reason: Dust is everywhere and has no value. Blood, which stood for life and was to be covered (Leviticus 17:13), is spilled like dirt on the ground. |

decisions.choice: their dead bodies will lie on the ground like dung (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says that the bodies are of the dead, and that they lie unburied, which the picture means. |

source.text: גַּם־כַּסְפָּ֨ם גַּם־זְהָבָ֜ם לֹֽא־יוּכַ֣ל לְהַצִּילָ֗ם בְּיוֹם֙ עֶבְרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וּבְאֵשׁ֙ קִנְאָת֔וֹ תֵּאָכֵ֖ל כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־כָלָ֤ה אַךְ־נִבְהָלָה֙ יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֵ֥ת כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Also their silver, also their gold will not be able to deliver them on [the] day of [the] fury of Yahweh; and in [the] fire of his jealousy all the earth will be consumed; for an end, yes, a terrifying [one], he will make of all [the] inhabitants of the earth.

en.L: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to rescue them \q on the day of the fury of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q and in the fire of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} jealousy all the earth will be consumed; \q for a full end, indeed a terrifying one, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will make \q of all the inhabitants of the earth.
en.B: Neither their silver nor their gold \q will be able to save them on the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s fury. \q In the fire of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} jealous anger the whole earth will be consumed, \q for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will make an end, a sudden and terrible end, \q of all who live on the earth.
en.R: Their silver and gold will not be able to save them \q on the day when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} shows {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger. \q His jealous anger will burn like fire and destroy the whole earth. \q He will suddenly put an end to everyone who lives on the earth.

es.L: Ni su plata ni su oro podrán librarlos \q en el día del furor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; \q y en el fuego de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} celo será consumida toda la tierra; \q porque un fin completo, sí, terrible, hará \q de todos los habitantes de la tierra.
es.B: Ni su plata ni su oro \q podrán salvarlos en el día del furor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q En el fuego de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira celosa será consumida toda la tierra, \q porque pondrá fin, un fin repentino y terrible, \q a todos los que viven en la tierra.
es.R: Su plata y su oro no podrán salvarlos \q el día en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} muestre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enojo. \q Su ira celosa arderá como fuego y destruirá toda la tierra. \q De repente acabará con todos los que viven en la tierra.

fr.L: Ni leur argent ni leur or ne pourront les délivrer \q au jour de la fureur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; \q et par le feu de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} jalousie toute la terre sera dévorée ; \q car une destruction totale, oui, terrifiante, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera \q de tous les habitants de la terre.
fr.B: Ni leur argent ni leur or \q ne pourront les sauver au jour de la fureur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q Par le feu de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère jalouse, toute la terre sera dévorée, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mettra fin, d’une fin soudaine et terrible, \q à tous ceux qui habitent la terre.
fr.R: Leur argent et leur or ne pourront pas les sauver \q le jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} montrera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère. \q Sa colère jalouse brûlera comme un feu et détruira toute la terre. \q Soudain, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera disparaître tous ceux qui vivent sur la terre.

sw.L: Fedha yao wala dhahabu yao hazitaweza kuwaokoa \q katika siku ya ghadhabu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q na katika moto wa wivu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} dunia yote itateketezwa; \q kwa maana mwisho kamili, naam, wa kutisha, atafanya \q kwa wakaaji wote wa dunia.
sw.B: Fedha yao wala dhahabu yao \q hazitaweza kuwaokoa katika siku ya ghadhabu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Katika moto wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya wivu dunia yote itateketezwa, \q kwa maana atawakomesha ghafla na kwa namna ya kutisha \q wote wanaoishi duniani.
sw.R: Fedha na dhahabu yao haitaweza kuwaokoa \q siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakapoonyesha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya wivu itawaka kama moto na kuiangamiza dunia yote. \q Ghafla atawakomesha wote wanaoishi duniani.

vi.L: Cả bạc lẫn vàng của chúng đều không thể giải cứu chúng \q trong ngày thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q trong lửa ghen của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cả trái đất sẽ bị thiêu nuốt; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm một sự tận diệt, phải, một sự tận diệt khủng khiếp, \q cho mọi cư dân trên đất.
vi.B: Cả bạc lẫn vàng của chúng \q đều không thể cứu chúng trong ngày thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Trong ngọn lửa ghen giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cả trái đất sẽ bị thiêu nuốt, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ kết liễu, một cách thình lình và khủng khiếp, \q mọi kẻ sống trên đất.
vi.R: Bạc và vàng của chúng sẽ không thể cứu chúng \q trong ngày {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tỏ cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Cơn ghen giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bùng cháy như lửa và hủy diệt cả trái đất. \q Ngài sẽ thình lình kết liễu mọi người sống trên đất.

ko.L: 그들의 은도 그들의 금도 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노의 날에 그들을 건질 수 없을 것이다. \q 그분의 질투의 불에 온 땅이 삼켜질 것이다. \q 참으로 그분께서 완전한 끝을, 정녕 무서운 끝을 \q 땅의 모든 주민에게 내리실 것이다.
ko.B: 그들의 은과 금도 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노의 날에 그들을 구해 내지 못할 것이다. \q 그분의 질투하는 분노의 불에 온 땅이 삼켜질 것이다. \q 그분께서 갑작스럽고 무서운 끝을 \q 땅에 사는 모든 사람에게 내리실 것이다.
ko.R: 그들의 은과 금도 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 분노를 쏟으시는 날에 그들을 구해 주지 못할 것이다. \q 그분의 질투하는 분노가 불처럼 타올라 온 땅을 멸망시킬 것이다. \q 그분께서 땅에 사는 모든 사람을 갑자기 없애실 것이다.

decisions.choice: their silver and their gold will not be able to deliver them: the words of Ezekiel 7:19
decisions.reason: Ezekiel 7:19 says almost the same of the day of the LORD's wrath. The wealth the merchants of verse 11 gathered cannot buy them off. |

decisions.choice: his jealousy: his burning zeal for what is his, not envy
decisions.reason: The LORD's jealousy is the passion with which he claims the loyalty owed to him alone, as a husband claims his wife's (Exodus 20:5; Deuteronomy 4:24, "a consuming fire, a jealous God"). The same line returns in 3:8. |

decisions.choice: terrifying: sudden and dreadful
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning both "terrify" and "hurry". The end will come quickly, and it will be terrible.

decisions.choice: all the earth ... all the inhabitants of the earth: the whole world
alternatives: all the land ... all the inhabitants of the land
decisions.reason: The word can mean "earth" or "land". Verses 2-3 speak of everything on the face of the ground, and 3:8 repeats "all the earth will be consumed" of the nations, so the whole earth is meant. The judgment that falls on Judah is part of the judgment of all the world.

decisions.choice: jealousy (L), jealous anger (B, R); a terrifying one (L), a sudden and terrible end (B), suddenly (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "jealous anger" so that the word is not taken as envy (m2). Balanced gives both senses of the rare word (m3); Readable keeps "suddenly" and leaves the terror to the rest of the verse. |

decisions.choice: the wording of Ezekiel 7:19 for the first lines; "celo" (L), "ira celosa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah says almost the same as Ezekiel 7:19 (m1), each level uses the Spanish published there. God's jealousy is "celo", as Ezekiel 36:5 and Deuteronomy 4:24 ("Dios celoso"); Balanced and Readable say "ira celosa" so that it is not read as envy (m2).

decisions.choice: the wording of Ezekiel 7:19 for the first lines; "jalousie" (L), "colère jalouse" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah says almost the same as Ezekiel 7:19 (m1), each level uses the French published there. God's jealousy is "jalousie" as Ezekiel 36:5, "colère jalouse" at Balanced and Readable as the English (m2).

decisions.choice: the wording of Ezekiel 7:19 for the first lines; "wivu" (L), "hasira ya wivu" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah says almost the same as Ezekiel 7:19 (m1), each level uses the Swahili published there. God's jealousy is "wivu" as Deuteronomy 4:24 and Ezekiel 36:5.

decisions.choice: the wording of Ezekiel 7:19 for the first lines; "lửa ghen" (L), "cơn ghen giận" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah says almost the same as Ezekiel 7:19 (m1), each level uses the Vietnamese published there. God's jealousy is "lửa ghen" as Ezekiel 36:5, "ghen giận" at Balanced and Readable so that it is not read as envy (m2).

decisions.choice: the wording of Ezekiel 7:19 for the first lines; "질투의 불" (L), "질투하는 분노" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Where Zephaniah says almost the same as Ezekiel 7:19 (m1), each level uses the Korean published there. The prophet speaks about the LORD here, so he takes -시- and 그분.
